title: Neuro-Symbolic Indirect-Call Analysis under Opaque Pointers
title_zh: 神经符号不透明间接调用分析

paragraphs.en: Resolving indirect calls is central to call-graph construction for C. Scalable type-based analyses such as MLTA use type information in LLVM IR to associate indirect calls with functions assigned to the corresponding structure fields. However, a single pointee type often misrepresents the memory a pointer addresses, and LLVM 17 removed pointee types in favor of opaque pointers. Therefore, field-sensitive analyses lose their matching key. Recovering the erased types restores the matching key but still misses the relation that the type encoded: which functions the program assigns to the field. We present Facet , to our knowledge the first analysis that reconstructs this dispatch relation over opaque IR. Facet identifies the structure field from which an indirect call loads its function pointer. It separately recovers the functions assigned to that field through initializers, stores, and aggregate copies. It then joins the two by field identity, without requiring an end-to-end value-flow path. Facet classifies proposed call-graph changes under distinct evidence rules for edge addition and removal and records the assumption behind each refinement. An LLM decides only the residual cases among symbolically bounded candidates. One analysis yields both a recall-preserving call graph and a refined call graph. On 14 C programs, Facet reduces the mean target-set size from 25.9 to 5.2 and raises observed recall from 0.79 to 0.99. Its recovered field identities agree with typed IR at 98.1% of jointly resolved sites. Applied to bug detection, the refined call graph found 17 deep bugs in C software from nginx to the Linux kernel, three of them latent for over a decade; 12 are confirmed.
paragraphs.zh: 解决间接调用是构建 C 语言程序调用图的核心问题。 可扩展的类型化分析（如 MLTA）利用 LLVM IR 中的类型信息，将间接调用与分配给对应结构体字段的函数关联起来。 然而，单一的点指类型常常无法准确表示指针所指向的内存，因此 LLVM 17 移除了点指类型，转而使用不透明指针。 因此，字段敏感分析失去了其匹配的关键依据。 恢复被删除的类型可以重新获得匹配关键，但仍然遗漏了类型所编码的关系：即程序将哪些函数分配给该字段。 我们提出了 Facet——据我们所知，这是首个能够基于不透明 IR 重建这种分发关系的分析方法。 Facet 能够确定间接调用加载其函数指针时所使用的结构体字段。 它还能分别恢复通过初始化器、存储操作和聚合复制分配给该字段的函数。 随后，它通过字段身份将两者关联起来，而无需端到端的值流路径。 Facet 针对边的添加和删除，依据不同的证据规则对提议的调用图变更进行分类，并记录每次精简化背后的假设。 LLM 仅需要在符号化约束的候选方案中决定剩余的特殊情况。 一种分析方法可同时生成一个保持召回率的调用图和一个经过精细化的调用图。 在 14 个 C 语言程序上，Facet 将目标集的平均大小从 25.9 降低至 5.2，并将观察到的召回率从 0.79 提升至 0.99。 在共同解析的 98.1% 的位置中，其恢复的字段身份与类型化 IR 一致。 在缺陷检测应用中，该精细化的调用图在从 nginx 到 Linux 内核的 C 语言软件中发现了 17 个深层缺陷，其中三个已潜伏超过十年；已有 12 个得到确认。

paragraphs.en: Whole-program call graphs are the basis of bug finding, taint tracking, control-flow integrity (CFI) hardening ( Abadi et al., 2005 ) , and compiler optimization for C. Their central difficulty is the indirect call ( icall hereafter), a call through a function pointer whose target is fixed only at run time. Such calls are common: the Linux 5.1 kernel contains roughly 58,000 icalls ( Lu and Hu, 2019 ) , and our 250 KLoC subject nginx contains 351. A call graph that misses an icall target is unsound for every client ( Reif et al., 2019 ) , and an over-approximate one gives every client spurious edges.
paragraphs.zh: 全程序调用图是发现漏洞、追踪污染、加强控制流完整性（CFI）（Abadi 等人，2005）以及 C 语言编译器优化的基础。 其核心难题是间接调用（下文简称 icall），即通过函数指针进行的调用，其目标仅在运行时确定。 这类调用十分常见：Linux 5.1 内核包含约 58,000 个 icall（Lu 和 Hu，2019），而我们研究的 250 KLoC 的 nginx 项目则包含 351 个。 任何遗漏了 icall 目标的调用图对于所有客户端而言都是不准确的（Reif 等人，2019），而过度的近似调用图则会为每个客户端引入虚假的边。

paragraphs.en: Three families of analysis resolve icalls . Pointer analysis ( Andersen, 1994 ; Emami et al., 1994 ; Sui and Xue, 2016 ) follows the value flow from each function to the calls it reaches. Type-based analysis ( Tice et al., 2014 ; Ge et al., 2016 ; Lu and Hu, 2019 ; Lu, 2023 ; Cai et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2025b ) keys a site to the functions of a compatible type. FLTA ( Tice et al., 2014 ; Ge et al., 2016 ) matches by signature alone. MLTA ( Lu and Hu, 2019 ) matches by the declared type of the structure field that the site loads from, and TyPM ( Lu, 2023 ) , Kelp ( Cai et al., 2024 ) , and KallGraph ( Li et al., 2025b ) refine it. LLM-based analysis ( Cheng et al., 2024 ) asks a model whether a caller and a candidate callee are semantically compatible. Field-type matching is the scalable choice, but its matching key is fragile: a cast can set a pointee type to anything, and one pointer may hold objects of different types on different paths ( Zhou et al., 2025 ; LLVM Project, 2026 ) . Since LLVM 17, the matching key is absent altogether: every pointer is the single type ptr , so a structure field’s declared pointee type is erased with it. The effect is concrete: MLTA resolves none of nginx ’s icalls , and with signature matching as the only remaining key, nginx ’s initial call graph still holds 87.8 87.8 targets per site ( Table 2 ). TypeCopilot ( Zhou et al., 2025 ) is the only prior icall analysis built for opaque IR; it re-infers the erased types so that MLTA can run unchanged. However, a recovered type set only bounds what a field may hold. It does not determine which functions the program assigns to that field (§ 2.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 三种分析家族能够解析 icalls。 指针分析（Andersen, 1994；Emami 等, 1994；Sui 和 Xue, 2016）追踪从每个函数到其可达调用的值流。 基于类型的分析（Tice 等, 2014；Ge 等, 2016；Lu 和 Hu, 2019；Lu, 2023；Cai 等, 2024；Li 等, 2025b）根据兼容类型的函数来关联一个位置。 FLTA（Tice 等, 2014；Ge 等, 2016）仅通过签名进行匹配。 MLTA（Lu 和 Hu, 2019）通过该位置加载的结构字段所声明的类型进行匹配，而 TyPM（Lu, 2023）、Kelp（Cai 等, 2024）和 KallGraph（Li 等, 2025b）则对此进行了细化。 LLM 基于分析（Cheng 等, 2024）会询问模型，判断调用者与候选被调用者在语义上是否兼容。 字段类型匹配是一种可扩展的选择，但其匹配键较为脆弱：一次类型转换可能将目标对象的类型设为任意类型，且一个指针在不同路径上可能持有不同类型的对象（Zhou 等, 2025；LLVM Project, 2026）。 自 LLVM 17 版本起，匹配键已完全消失：所有指针均为单一类型 ptr，因此结构字段所声明的目标对象类型也随之被抹除。 其影响是具体的：MLTA 无法解析 nginx 的任何 icalls，而仅保留签名匹配作为唯一匹配键时，nginx 的初始调用图每个位置仍包含 87.8 个目标（表 2）。 TypeCopilot（Zhou 等, 2025）是唯一专为不透明 IR 构建的早期 icall 分析；它能重新推断被抹除的类型，使 MLTA 无需修改即可运行。 然而，恢复后的类型集合仅能界定一个字段可能包含的内容。 它无法确定程序将哪些函数分配给该字段（§ 2.2）。

paragraphs.en: Key insight. Opaque pointers erase the matching key, but the dispatch it encoded is preserved in the program: a function is still stored into a structure field and later loaded from it. Two sources remain after the erasure: the debug information still names the field at the load’s byte offset, and the points-to solution already computed records the functions assigned to that field. Therefore, we do not restore the types. Instead, we reconstruct the relation that they encoded: from each call site to its dispatched field, and from each field to the functions assigned to it.
paragraphs.zh: 关键见解。 不透明指针会删除匹配的键，但其所编码的分发信息仍保留在程序中：函数仍然被存储到结构体字段中，并随后从该字段加载。 删除操作后仍剩下两个来源：调试信息仍然在加载的字节偏移处标明了该字段，而先前已计算出的“指向”解则记录了分配给该字段的函数。 因此，我们不恢复这些类型。 相反，我们重建它们所编码的关系：从每个调用点到其分发到的字段，以及从每个字段到分配给它的函数。

sents.en: Key insight.
sents.zh: 关键见解。

sents.en: Therefore, we do not restore the types.
sents.zh: 因此，我们不恢复这些类型。

sents.en: Instead, we reconstruct the relation that they encoded: from each call site to its dispatched field, and from each field to the functions assigned to it.
sents.zh: 相反，我们重建它们所编码的关系：从每个调用点到其分发到的字段，以及从每个字段到分配给它的函数。

paragraphs.en: Reconstructing this relation in practice raises three challenges. C1: Implicit assignments. A field’s assignment set is not explicit in the IR. On our subjects, 60.4 % 60.4\% of the recovered assignments arrive through pointer copies, parameter bindings, and aggregate assignments that lower to a bulk copy with no store instruction. The value flow into the field may also pass through data that the pointer analysis cannot trace (§ 2.2 ). C2: Evidence asymmetry. Adding an edge requires evidence that a target is possible. Removing one requires evidence that it is impossible, which a target’s absence from a may-analysis does not provide. MLTA has this weakness: it excludes an address-taken function whenever the search for its enclosing layers fails, which causes most of its independently verified missed targets ( Li et al., 2025b ) . C3: Residual ambiguity. Candidates that share the dispatched field and its signature differ only in the role that their names and bodies express. An LLM can recognize this role, and a symbolic analysis cannot. LLMs, however, hallucinate and are non-deterministic ( Cheng et al., 2024 ) , so what a model may change must be bounded.
paragraphs.zh: 在实践中重构这种关系会引发三个挑战。 C1：隐式赋值。 某个字段的赋值集合在 IR 中并未明确给出。 在我们的测试用例中，60.4 % 60.4\% 的已恢复赋值是通过指针复制、参数绑定以及可降级为无存储指令的批量复制的聚合赋值获得的。 流入该字段的值也可能经过指针分析无法追踪的数据（§ 2.2）。C2：证据不对称性。 添加一条边需要存在证明目标可行的证据。 移除一条边则需要证明其不可能的证据，而目标在 may-analysis 中的缺失并不能提供这种证据。 MLTA 存在这一弱点：当搜索其包围层失败时，它会排除一个地址被使用的函数，这导致其大多数独立验证过的漏检目标（Li et al., 2025b）。C3：残留歧义。 共享了被调用的字段及其签名的候选者之间唯一的区别在于它们的名称和函数体所表达的角色不同。 LLM 能够识别这种角色，而符号分析则无法做到。 然而，LLM 会产生幻觉且是非确定性的（Cheng et al., 2024），因此模型可能改变的内容必须受到限制。

sents.zh: 共享了被调用的字段及其签名的候选者之间唯一的区别在于它们的名称和函数体所表达的角色不同。

sents.en: An LLM can recognize this role, and a symbolic analysis cannot.
sents.zh: LLM 能够识别这种角色，而符号分析则无法做到。

sents.en: LLMs, however, hallucinate and are non-deterministic ( Cheng et al., 2024 ) , so what a model may change must be bounded.
sents.zh: 然而，LLM 会产生幻觉且是非确定性的（Cheng et al., 2024），因此模型可能改变的内容必须受到限制。

paragraphs.en: Our approach. We present Facet , which reconstructs this relation over opaque IR and refines a pointer-analysis call graph with it. Facet first identifies the structure field an indirect call loads its function pointer from, using the object layout and the load’s byte offset. For C1 , it recovers the functions assigned to that field by projecting the solved points-to relation onto the field, so assignments that arrive through copies and parameter bindings are recovered together with direct stores. It then joins the dispatched field and its assigned functions by field identity. For C2 , Facet classifies each proposed change under distinct evidence rules for adding and for removing an edge: an addition needs a positive witness, and a removal needs evidence that excludes the target. It records the rule and the assumption behind each change, so its provenance yields two call graphs. The recall-preserving R + R^{+} admits only changes that need no assumption. Hence, a client that must not lose an edge, such as CFI ( Abadi et al., 2005 ; Tice et al., 2014 ; Burow et al., 2017 ) , uses R + R^{+} . A client that values precision, such as bug detection ( Sui et al., 2012 ; Shi et al., 2018 ; Lu et al., 2019 ) , uses the refined R ± R^{\pm} . For C3 , Facet adopts a neuro-symbolic design: an LLM decides only the cases that evidence leaves open. We evaluate Facet on 14 C programs of 12K to 620 KLoC. It reduces the mean target set from 25.9 25.9 to 5.2 5.2 per site. It also outperforms the state of the art: its macro F1 is 0.702 0.702 , against 0.509 0.509 for the best prior tool (§ 4 ). Applied to bug detection, the refined call graph found 17 deep bugs in widely used C software, including three in the kernel’s ext4 file system that were latent for at least 14 years (§ 4.6 ). Maintainers have confirmed 12 of them.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的方法。 我们提出了 Facet，它能在不透明的 IR 上重建这种关系，并据此优化指针分析生成的调用图。 Facet 首先利用对象布局和加载操作的字节偏移量，确定间接调用加载其函数指针的结构字段。 对于 C1，它通过将求解出的“点到”关系投影到该字段上，恢复分配给该字段的函数，从而连同直接存储操作一起恢复通过复制和参数绑定传入的赋值操作。 接着，它根据字段身份将调用的字段与其分配的函数关联起来。 对于 C2，Facet 依据添加和移除边的不同证据规则对每个提议的变更进行分类：添加需要正向证据，而移除则需要排除目标的证据。 它会记录每次变更所依据的规则和假设，因此其来源信息能生成两个调用图。 保持召回率的 R + R^{+} 仅允许无需任何假设的变更。 因此，不能丢失任何边的客户端（如 CFI (Abadi et al., 2005; Tice et al., 2014; Burow et al., 2017)）会使用 R + R^{+}。 重视精确度的客户端（如错误检测 (Sui et al., 2012; Shi et al., 2018; Lu et al., 2019)）则会使用优化后的 R ± R^{\pm}。 对于 C3，Facet 采用神经符号设计：仅由 LLM 决定证据未明确覆盖的情况。 我们在 14 个代码量从 12K 到 620 KLoC 的 C 程序上对 Facet 进行了评估。 它将每个位置的平均目标集从 25.9 减少到了 5.2。 它的性能也优于当前最优方法：其宏观 F1 为 0.702，而此前最佳工具的宏观 F1 仅为 0.509 (§ 4)。 在错误检测应用中，优化后的调用图在广泛使用的 C 软件中发现了 17 个深层漏洞，其中包括内核 ext4 文件系统中潜伏了至少 14 年的三个漏洞 (§ 4.6)。 维护人员已确认其中 12 个漏洞。

paragraphs.en: Problem formulation. We formulate indirect-call resolution under opaque pointers as reconstructing the dispatch relation, from call site to dispatched field and from field to assigned functions, rather than recovering the erased types (§ 2.2 –§ 2.3 ).

paragraphs.en: Since LLVM 17, every pointer type T* in the IR is the single type ptr , including those in function signatures and struct layouts ( LLVM Project, 2026 ) . 1 1 1 Opaque pointers became the default in LLVM 15; typed pointers were deprecated in 16 and removed in 17 ( LLVM Project, 2026 ) . Hence, the IR records no declared type for a function-pointer field. Figure 1 (a) shows a running example about nginx ’s module initialization. The struct ngx_http_module_t declares its callbacks as function-pointer fields, three of which share one signature. The icall site c c at line 9 loads its callee from one of the three, create_loc_conf , written 𝑑𝑖𝑠𝑝 ⁡ ( c ) \mathit{disp}(c) . The 25 implementations that the module tables store into this field are the observed targets of c c . In nginx ’s opaque IR, the number of struct fields typed as function pointers falls from 813 to zero.
paragraphs.zh: 自 LLVM 17 版本以来，IR 中的每个指针类型 T* 都统一为单一类型 ptr，包括函数签名和结构体布局中的指针（LLVM Project, 2026）。不透明指针在 LLVM 15 版本中成为默认类型；带类型指针在 16 版本中被弃用，并在 17 版本中被移除（LLVM Project, 2026）。 因此，IR 不会为函数指针字段记录任何声明的类型。 图 1(a) 展示了一个关于 nginx 模块初始化的运行示例。 结构体 ngx_http_module_t 将其回调函数声明为函数指针字段，其中三个字段共享相同的函数签名。 第 9 行的 icall 指令从这三个字段之一（create_loc_conf）加载其被调用函数，写作 𝑑𝑖𝑠𝑝 ⁡ ( c ) \mathit{disp}(c)。 模块表存储在该字段中的 25 个实现，正是 c 的实际目标。 在 nginx 的不透明 IR 中，被声明为函数指针的结构体字段数量从 813 个减少到零。

paragraphs.en: We continue with the running example, in which the dispatch is a store-to-load chain: the module table stores the implementation into the field and the site loads it back. None of the three families reconstructs this chain from the IR it is given. Pointer analysis such as Andersen’s follows value flows. However, the flow into the field passes through the module array, which Andersen’s analysis cannot traverse. Hence, Andersen’s analysis returns the empty set. Type-based analysis keys the site to functions of a compatible type, but opaque IR leaves it only the signature. Field-type matching by MLTA ( Lu and Hu, 2019 ) needs the declared type of the loaded field, so it resolves none of nginx ’s 351 icalls . Signature matching by FLTA uses the signature that the three sibling fields share. Hence, it cannot separate the 41 implementations stored into the three fields, 25, 6, and 10 respectively. TypeCopilot ( Zhou et al., 2025 ) first re-infers the erased types, which restores the matching key. However, a recovered type set only bounds what a field may hold and does not determine which functions the program assigns to it (§ 4.4 ). LLM-based analysis such as SEA ( Cheng et al., 2024 ) uses the source names but has no representation of the dispatched field. At this site, SEA returns 42 targets: the 25 observed ones and 17 others. Its decision is adopted unchecked, so nothing records the evidence behind a kept target and a misprediction remains uncorrected ( Venkatesh et al., 2024 ; Venkatesh et al., 2025 ) . None of them recovers the field the site dispatches through, which the IR no longer names.
paragraphs.zh: 我们继续使用这个运行中的示例，其中调度是一个存储到加载链：模块表将实现存储到该字段中，而站点则将其重新加载。 这三种方法中没有任何一种能够从给定的中间表示（IR）中重构出这条链。 像 Andersen 方法这样的指针分析会追踪值的流动。 然而，流入该字段的流经过了模块数组，而 Andersen 的分析无法遍历该数组。 因此，Andersen 的分析返回了空集。 基于类型的分析方法将站点与兼容类型的函数关联起来，但不透明的中间表示（IR）只留下了函数签名。 MLTA（Lu 和 Hu，2019）的字段类型匹配需要已加载字段的声明类型，因此它无法解析 nginx 中的 351 个 icalls。 FLTA 的签名匹配方法使用了三个兄弟字段所共享的签名。 因此，它无法区分存储在这三个字段中的 41 个实现，这三个字段分别存储了 25、6 和 10 个实现。 TypeCopilot（Zhou 等人，2025）首先重新推断被擦除的类型，从而恢复了匹配键。 然而，恢复后的类型集合只能界定一个字段可能包含的内容，而无法确定程序将哪些函数分配给它（§4.4）。 像 SEA（Cheng 等人，2024）这样的基于大语言模型的分析方法使用了源名称，但没有对调度字段的表示。 在该站点，SEA 返回了 42 个目标：25 个观察到的目标和另外 17 个目标。 其决策未经验证就被采用，因此没有任何记录保留某个被接受目标的依据，而误预测也未被纠正（Venkatesh 等人，2024；Venkatesh 等人，2025）。 这些方法中没有任何一种能够恢复出该站点所调度的字段，因为中间表示（IR）中已不再包含该字段的名称。

paragraphs.en: The dispatch, however, is still recoverable from two facts the IR keeps. For the first fact, the debug information records create_loc_conf at the load’s byte offset; this is the dispatched field 𝑑𝑖𝑠𝑝 ⁡ ( c ) \mathit{disp}(c) of Figure 1 (b). For the second fact, function constants keep their types, so the initializer slots that assign them stay identifiable; nginx has 804 such slots. The module tables store the 25 implementations into the field; this set is the initializer store-set 𝑖𝑛𝑖𝑡 ( S . m ) \mathit{init}(S{.}m) . Joining the two facts on the field needs no value flow: each of the 25 implementations is witnessed by a module table, and the sibling fields’ candidates are refuted by the same writes.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，从 IR 保留的两个事实中，仍然可以恢复该派发信息。 第一个事实是，调试信息记录了加载字节偏移处的 create_loc_conf；这对应于图 1(b) 中的已派发字段 𝑑𝑖𝑠𝑝 ⁡ ( c ) \mathit{disp}(c)。 第二个事实是，函数常量会保留其类型，因此分配它们的初始化槽仍然可以识别；nginx 有 804 个这样的槽。 模块表将 25 种实现存储到该字段中；这个集合就是初始化存储集 𝑖𝑛𝑖𝑡 ( S . m ) \mathit{init}(S{.}m)。 通过该字段将这两个事实关联起来无需任何值流：25 种实现中的每一种都由一个模块表所证实，而兄弟字段的候选项则被相同的写入操作所否定。

Taken over all of C C , a resolver is the icall call graph of M M , as in control flow analysis for first-class functions ( Møller and Schwartzbach, 2026 ) . An existing analysis computes the initial resolver R 0 R_{0} on M M ; § 3.2 defines ours. Let T ⁡ ( c ) ⊆ 𝐹𝑢𝑛 T(c)\subseteq\mathit{Fun} be the functions that c c invokes in some execution of M M . R R is sound at c c iff T ⁡ ( c ) ⊆ R ⁡ ( c ) T(c)\subseteq R(c) , soundness with identity concretization ( Cousot and Cousot, 1977 ; Møller and Schwartzbach, 2026 ) .

paragraphs.en: As shown in Figure 2 , Facet takes the input and refines its initial call graph in three stages: Dispatch-relation reconstruction (§ 3.2 ) recovers 𝒟 ^ \widehat{\mathcal{D}} from the debug layouts and the points-to solution. It proposes each edge of 𝒟 ^ \widehat{\mathcal{D}} as a call-target fact ⟨ c , f , 𝑝𝑜𝑙 ⟩ \langle c,f,\mathit{pol}\rangle with 𝑝𝑜𝑙 ∈ { add , prune } \mathit{pol}\in\{\textsf{add},\textsf{prune}\} , which modifies R 0 R_{0} . Warrant-based classification (§ 3.3 ) sorts every fact by program evidence into supported , rejected , or residual . Neuro-symbolic residual resolution (§ 3.4 ) then lets an LLM decide the residual facts among candidates that the symbolic stages have bounded. The provenance records every decision. From it, call-graph derivation (§ 3.5 ) derives the recall-preserving R + R^{+} and the refined R ± R^{\pm} .
paragraphs.zh: 如图 2 所示，Facet 接收输入并通过三个阶段优化其初始调用图：派遣关系重建（§ 3.2）从调试布局和点到解中恢复 𝒟 ^ \widehat{\mathcal{D}}。 它将 𝒟 ^ \widehat{\mathcal{D}} 中的每条边提议为一个调用目标事实 ⟨ c , f , 𝑝𝑜𝑙 ⟩ \langle c,f,\mathit{pol}\rangle，其中 𝑝𝑜𝑙 ∈ { add , prune } \mathit{pol}\in\{\textsf{add},\textsf{prune}\}，从而修改 R 0 R_{0}。 基于依据的分类（§ 3.3）根据程序证据将每个事实分为支持、拒绝或剩余三类。 随后，神经符号剩余解析（§ 3.4）允许 LLM 在符号阶段已界定的候选项中决定剩余事实。 来源记录会记录每一个决策。 基于此，调用图推导（§ 3.5）可推导出保留召回率的 R + R^{+} 和优化的 R ± R^{\pm}。

paragraphs.en: Facet builds R 0 R_{0} once, on Andersen’s analysis, because the projection below uses the same points-to solution. At each site c c , R 0 R_{0} holds the functions in the points-to set of the callee pointer, which Andersen’s points-to solution 𝑝𝑡 \mathit{pt} records ( Møller and Schwartzbach, 2026 ) . R 0 R_{0} intersects this set with the FLTA signature match over the address-taken functions 𝐴𝑇 \mathit{AT} ( Tice et al., 2014 ; Ge et al., 2016 ) . The signature match is the coarsest type filter that opaque IR still supports, so R 0 R_{0} keeps Andersen’s recall.
paragraphs.zh: 根据 Andersen 的分析，Facet 会一次性构建 R 0 R_{0}，因为下方的投影使用了相同的“点到”解。 在每个位置 c c 处，R 0 R_{0} 包含被调用指针的“点到”集合中的函数，这些函数由 Andersen 的“点到”解 𝑝𝑡 \mathit{pt} 记录（Møller 和 Schwartzbach，2026）。 R 0 R_{0} 与该集合在地址取用函数 𝐴𝑇 \mathit{AT} 上的 FLTA 签名匹配部分求交集（Tice 等人，2014；Ge 等人，2016）。 该签名匹配是 opaque IR 仍然支持的最粗略的类型过滤器，因此 R 0 R_{0} 保留了 Andersen 的召回能力。

paragraphs.en: At an icall c c , the callee is loaded through a pointer p p at a constant byte offset k k . In optimized opaque IR, a field access is byte arithmetic that names no struct, so k k accumulates over the chain of address computations that feeds the load. Therefore, recovering 𝑑𝑖𝑠𝑝 ⁡ ( c ) = ( S , m ) \mathit{disp}(c)=(S,m) of Definition 1 needs two things: the aggregate type S S that p p points to, and the field m m at offset k k of S S ’s layout. Neither is in the IR, but the debug information still records source-level types ( Hück et al., 2025 ) , so both follow once the recorded type of p p is known.
paragraphs.zh: 在调用 c 时，被调用对象通过指针 p p 以固定的字节偏移量 k k 加载。 在优化后的不透明 IR 中，字段访问是一种字节算术操作，它不指定任何结构体，因此 k k 会在构成加载操作的地址计算链中逐步累加。 因此，恢复定义 1 中的 𝑑𝑖𝑠𝑝 ⁡ ( c ) = ( S , m ) \mathit{disp}(c)=(S,m) 需要两个要素：p p 所指向的聚合类型 S S，以及 S S 布局中偏移量为 k k 的字段 m m。 IR 中并不包含这两个要素，但调试信息仍然记录了源代码级别的类型（Hück et al., 2025），因此一旦知道了 p p 的记录类型，这两个要素都可以确定下来。

paragraphs.en: Facet finds that type in three steps, ordered from the most direct evidence to the least, and stops at the first that succeeds. ❶ Direct. A debug record binds p p to a source variable of recorded type S ∗ S{*} : in optimized IR, a value record on p p itself; in unoptimized IR, a declaration record on the stack slot from which p p is loaded. Only a record with an empty location expression is accepted, because after inlining, p p also has records for locations derived from it, and their types are not p p ’s. A lock embedded in the object is one such location. ❷ Chained. No record names p p , but p p is loaded from a field of a receiver that step ❶ resolves. For example, in cinfo->master->prepare() , the inner pointer is a temporary that no variable names. That field is resolved by the same steps and its recorded pointer type is followed to the pointee struct. To bound the cost of following pointer members through the object graph, we cap the recursion at depth four; the example above needs depth two. A chain beyond the cap is left unrecovered. ❸ Typed access. The address computation still names a struct type, as it does in unoptimized IR, and that name is looked up in the debug index. Whichever step succeeds determines S S .
paragraphs.zh: Facet 通过三个步骤找到该类型，顺序从最直接的证据到最不直接的证据，并在第一个成功的步骤处停止。❶ 直接法。 一个调试记录将 p p 绑定到一个类型为 S ∗ S{*} 的源变量上：在优化后的 IR 中，这是 p p 本身上的一个值记录；在未优化的 IR 中，这是栈槽中加载 p p 的一个声明记录。 只有位置表达式为空的记录才会被接受，因为在内联之后，p p 也会有源自它的位置的记录，而这些位置的类型并非 p p 的类型。 嵌入在对象中的一个锁就是这样一个位置。❷ 链式法。 没有任何记录命名 p p ，但 p p 是从一个接收器的字段中加载的，而该字段由步骤❶解析确定。 例如，在 cinfo->master->prepare() 中，内部指针是一个临时变量，没有变量为其命名。 该字段通过相同的步骤进行解析，并且其记录的类型指针会被追溯至被指向的结构体。 为了限制遍历对象图中指针成员的成本，我们将递归深度限制为四；上述示例需要深度为二。 超出深度限制的链式结构将不会被恢复。❸ 类型化访问。 地址计算仍然会命名一个结构体类型，就像在未优化的 IR 中一样，并且该名称会在调试索引中查找。 无论哪个步骤成功，都将决定 S S 。

paragraphs.en: Once S S is fixed, m m is taken from S S ’s layout at offset k k , with three adjustments to the field key. The analysis descends into an embedded named struct at that offset. Hence, a wrapper type that dispatches through an embedded base struct is keyed on the base struct’s field. Thus, its sites join the writes made through the base type, as my_upsampler does through jpeg_upsampler . An anonymous union is one location, so the field key stops at the enclosing named field and covers every member. A dispatch through a plain global function pointer or a constant-indexed global array involves no struct, so it is keyed on the variable name instead. The site of Figure 1 needs no adjustment: the callee is loaded at offset 48 from a pointer recorded as ngx_http_module_t* , and the layout places create_loc_conf there with signature void*(ngx_conf_t*) . This declared signature is 𝑠𝑖𝑔 ( S . m ) \mathit{sig}(S{.}m) , the type evidence the projection’s filter (§ 3.2.2 ) and Prune-Sig (§ 3.3.2 ) use.
paragraphs.zh: 一旦 S S 被固定，m m 就从 S S 的布局中偏移量 k k 处获取，并对字段键进行三项调整。 分析会深入到该偏移量处的一个嵌入式命名结构体中。 因此，通过嵌入式基础结构体进行分发的包装类型，其键基于基础结构体的字段。 这样，它的站点就加入了通过基础类型进行的写入操作，正如 my_upsampler 通过 jpeg_upsampler 所做的那样。 匿名联合体只有一个位置，因此字段键会终止于包围它的命名字段，并覆盖所有成员。 通过普通全局函数指针或常量索引的全局数组进行分发时不涉及结构体，因此其键基于变量名。 图 1 中的站点无需调整：被调用者从记录为 ngx_http_module_t* 的指针偏移量 48 处加载，而布局将 create_loc_conf 放置在该位置，其签名为 void*(ngx_conf_t*) 。 这个声明的签名是 𝑠𝑖𝑔 ( S . m ) \mathit{sig}(S{.}m) ，即投影过滤器（§ 3.2.2 ）和 Prune-Sig（§ 3.3.2 ）使用的类型证据。

paragraphs.en: When none of the three steps applies, the symbolic stages yield no fact at the site. Such sites are 9.8 % 9.8\% of the ground-truth sites (§ 4.2 ). The residual resolution of § 3.4 still applies there, and its proposals are classified by Add-Untaken , by Add-Store when the proposal names the field, and otherwise by the ⊥ \bot rules. paragraphs.en: For the assignment set, Facet computes the approximation F ( S . m ) F(S{.}m) of Definition 1 by projecting the solved points-to relation onto fields ( Algorithm 1 ). To project is to index the writes that the points-to solution records by the field key ( S , m ) (S,m) rather than by object. Hence, every store into field m m of any object of type S S contributes to F ( S . m ) F(S{.}m) . The same type-level heap abstraction keeps a field-sensitive analysis tractable ( Tan et al., 2017 ) . This makes F F field-based (§ 2.3 ) and lets the two components join on one key.
paragraphs.zh: 对于该分配集，Facet 通过将求解出的点到关系投影到字段上（算法 1），计算出定义 1 中的近似值 F(S{.}m)。 投影即是指，根据字段键 (S,m) 而非对象来索引点到解记录中的写入操作。 因此，对任何类型 S 的对象中字段 m 的每次存储操作都会对 F(S{.}m) 产生贡献。 同一种类型级别的堆抽象使得字段敏感分析仍然具有可行性（Tan 等人，2017）。 这使得 F 成为基于字段的（§2.3），并允许两个组件通过一个键进行连接。

paragraphs.en: Formally, let [ [ o . m ] ] [\![o{.}m]\!] be the points-to set of field m m of abstract object o o in the field-sensitive solution ( Møller and Schwartzbach, 2026 ) . Then F ( S . m ) = { f ∈ 𝐹𝑢𝑛 ∩ ⋃ 𝑡𝑦𝑝𝑒 ⁡ ( o ) = S [ [ o . m ] ] ∣ 𝑠𝑖𝑔 ( f ) ∼ 𝑠𝑖𝑔 ( S . m ) } F(S{.}m)=\{f\in\mathit{Fun}\cap\bigcup_{\mathit{type}(o)=S}[\![o{.}m]\!]\mid\mathit{sig}(f)\sim\mathit{sig}(S{.}m)\} . The three forms of Algorithm 1 are the three kinds of statement through which a function reaches [ [ o . m ] ] [\![o{.}m]\!] . Form 0 traverses every global constant initializer under the global’s recorded type and records each function that the initializer places in a field. The recorded set is 𝑖𝑛𝑖𝑡 ( S . m ) \mathit{init}(S{.}m) , which serves as the witness of § 3.3.1 . Figure 3 shows Form 0 on the running example as a query plan. paragraphs.en: Forms 1 and 2 handle the writes that are not constant initializers. Form 1 keys a store address by the recovery of § 3.2.1 and takes the stored values from the points-to set that Andersen’s analysis has already computed. Form 2 distributes an aggregate copy field by field across the copied type. These two forms matter because counting only stores of a function constant would miss most assignments. The value that reaches a field is typically copied or bound as a parameter first. An aggregate assignment lowers to a bulk copy with no store instruction at all. Because projection widens F F , it is admitted only where the debug information types the field as a function pointer and only for signature-compatible candidates. The two components are then joined on the field key, so the product of reconstruction at a site c c is the candidate set F ⁡ ( 𝑑𝑖𝑠𝑝 ⁡ ( c ) ) F(\mathit{disp}(c)) . Reconstruction cannot decide the same-signature residual cases . These are candidates that the program may store into the field but that no analysis of the erased IR alone can distinguish. They are left to the LLM (§ 3.4 ).

paragraphs.en: A warrant for a call-target fact ϕ \phi is a triple ⟨ r , e , π ⟩ \langle r,e,\pi\rangle : a rule r r of Figure 4 that classifies ϕ \phi as supported or rejected , the evidence e e that r r checked, and the premise π \pi , an assumption about M M under which e e justifies the decision. It is premise-free if π = 𝑡𝑟𝑢𝑒 \pi{=}\mathit{true} and premised otherwise.
paragraphs.zh: 一个针对调用目标事实 ϕ 的令状是一个三元组 ⟨ r , e , π ⟩：即图 4 中的一条规则 r，它将 ϕ 分类为支持或拒绝；被 r 检查的证据 e；以及前提 π，即关于 M 的一个假设，在该假设下 e 能够证明该决策的合理性。 如果 π = 𝑡𝑟𝑢𝑒，则称为无前提的；否则称为有前提的。

paragraphs.en: As in argumentation theory ( Toulmin, 1958 ) , a warrant justifies one edge decision under π \pi and makes no claim about whether the edge is ever taken. For an add , it justifies that the program assigns f f to the dispatched field, f ∈ F ∗ ( S . m ) f\in F^{*}(S{.}m) of Definition 1 . For a prune , it justifies that removing f f keeps R R an over-approximation of T T at c c . Among the rules, Add-Witness and Add-Untaken are premise-free; Add-Store , Prune-Sig , and Prune-Store are premised, and Figure 4 states each premise. A premise-free decision is justified unconditionally, and a premised one only where π \pi holds ( Møller and Schwartzbach, 2026 ) . A soundy analysis must name that premise for its client ( Livshits et al., 2015 ) , and § 3.5 derives two call graphs from the distinction. The rules implement the asymmetry of C2 : an addition needs evidence that the target is possible, whereas a removal needs evidence that excludes it under a stated assumption.
paragraphs.zh: 正如论证理论（Toulmin，1958）中的情况一样，一个保证项为 π \pi 下的某条边的决策提供正当性，但并不对该边是否会被实际采用做出任何断言。 对于 Add 规则，它证明了程序将 f f 分配给定义 1 中已调用的字段 f ∈ F^{*}(S{.}m)。 对于 Prune 规则，它证明了移除 f f 后 R R 在 c c 处仍然是 T T 的一个上近似。 在这些规则中，Add-Witness 和 Add-Untaken 是无前提的；Add-Store、Prune-Sig 和 Prune-Store 则有前提，图 4 说明了每个前提。 无前提的决策是无条件被正当化的，而有前提的决策仅在 π \pi 成立时才是正当的（Møller 和 Schwartzbach，2026）。 一个健全的分析必须为其客户端明确说明该前提（Livshits 等，2015），并且 §3.5 基于这一区分推导出了两个调用图。 这些规则实现了 C2 的不对称性：添加操作需要证据表明目标状态是可能的，而移除操作则需要证据表明在某个已陈述的假设下该状态被排除。

paragraphs.en: An add is supported only by a positive witness that the program supplies. Add-Untaken comes first. It rejects any f ∉ 𝐴𝑇 f\notin\mathit{AT} , where 𝐴𝑇 \mathit{AT} is the address-taken set of § 3.2 . Because F ⊆ 𝐴𝑇 F\subseteq\mathit{AT} ( Algorithm 1 ), no symbolic fact fails it. Hence, the rule guards the model’s proposals (§ 3.4 ). Next comes Add-Witness , the initializer witness and the strongest rule. It applies when f ∈ 𝑖𝑛𝑖𝑡 ( S . m ) f\in\mathit{init}(S{.}m) for ( S , m ) = 𝑑𝑖𝑠𝑝 ⁡ ( c ) (S,m)=\mathit{disp}(c) . An initializer is program text, so f ∈ 𝑖𝑛𝑖𝑡 ( S . m ) ⊆ F ∗ ( S . m ) f\in\mathit{init}(S{.}m)\subseteq F^{*}(S{.}m) holds by Definition 1 without any assumption. In the running example, it warrants each of the 25 module-table entries. Last comes Add-Store , the runtime-store witness . It warrants an add whose target reaches F ( S . m ) F(S{.}m) through a store or a copy but through no initializer, that is, f ∈ F ( S . m ) ∖ 𝑖𝑛𝑖𝑡 ( S . m ) f\in F(S{.}m)\setminus\mathit{init}(S{.}m) . Its evidence is weaker than the initializer witness, which names f f in the field. A store contributes only the may points-to set of its value, and a copy contributes the points-to sets of the objects its source may point to ( Algorithm 1 ). Hence, the witness needs the premise π bind \pi_{\mathrm{bind}} that the projected assignment is realized: f ∈ F ∗ ( S . m ) f\in F^{*}(S{.}m) . The premise binds f f to the field on the strength of a may-analysis, which is why R + R^{+} excludes the additions of Add-Store . The two witnesses are compared in § 4.5 . An add that no rule supports is residual under Add- ⊥ \bot .

sents.en: It applies when f ∈ 𝑖𝑛𝑖𝑡 ( S . m ) f\in\mathit{init}(S{.}m) for ( S , m ) = 𝑑𝑖𝑠𝑝 ⁡ ( c ) (S,m)=\mathit{disp}(c) .
sents.zh: 当 f ∈ 𝑖𝑛𝑖𝑡 ( S . m ) f\in\mathit{init}(S{.}m) 且 (S,m)=𝑑𝑖𝑠𝑝 ⁡ ( c ) (S,m)=\mathit{disp}(c) 时，该规则适用。

sents.en: An initializer is program text, so f ∈ 𝑖𝑛𝑖𝑡 ( S . m ) ⊆ F ∗ ( S . m ) f\in\mathit{init}(S{.}m)\subseteq F^{*}(S{.}m) holds by Definition 1 without any assumption.
sents.zh: 初始化器是程序文本，因此根据定义 1，无需任何假设即可得出 f ∈ 𝑖𝑛𝑖𝑡 ( S . m ) ⊆ F ∗ ( S . m ) f\in\mathit{init}(S{.}m)\subseteq F^{*}(S{.}m) 成立。

sents.en: In the running example, it warrants each of the 25 module-table entries.
sents.zh: 在运行示例中，它证实了 25 个模块表条目中的每一个。

sents.en: Last comes Add-Store , the runtime-store witness .
sents.zh: 最后是 Add-Store，即运行时存储见证。

sents.en: It warrants an add whose target reaches F ( S . m ) F(S{.}m) through a store or a copy but through no initializer, that is, f ∈ F ( S . m ) ∖ 𝑖𝑛𝑖𝑡 ( S . m ) f\in F(S{.}m)\setminus\mathit{init}(S{.}m) .
sents.zh: 它证实了一个加法操作，其目标通过存储或复制访问 F ( S . m ) F(S{.}m)，但未经过任何初始化器，即 f ∈ F ( S . m ) ∖ 𝑖𝑛𝑖𝑡 ( S . m ) f\in F(S{.}m)\setminus\mathit{init}(S{.}m)。

sents.en: Its evidence is weaker than the initializer witness, which names f f in the field.
sents.zh: 其证据弱于初始化见证，后者在字段中明确指出了 f f。

sents.en: A store contributes only the may points-to set of its value, and a copy contributes the points-to sets of the objects its source may point to ( Algorithm 1 ).
sents.zh: 存储操作仅贡献其值的“可能指向”集合，而复制操作则贡献其源对象可能指向的对象的所有“指向”集合（算法 1）。

sents.en: Hence, the witness needs the premise π bind \pi_{\mathrm{bind}} that the projected assignment is realized: f ∈ F ∗ ( S . m ) f\in F^{*}(S{.}m) .
sents.zh: 因此，该见证需要前提 π bind \pi_{\mathrm{bind}}，即投影赋值必须实现：f ∈ F ∗ ( S . m ) f\in F^{*}(S{.}m)。

sents.en: The premise binds f f to the field on the strength of a may-analysis, which is why R + R^{+} excludes the additions of Add-Store .
sents.zh: 该前提基于“可能分析”将 f f 绑定到字段，这也是 R + R^{+} 排除 Add-Store 的加法操作的原因。

sents.en: The two witnesses are compared in § 4.5 .
sents.zh: 这两种见证将在 § 4.5 中进行比较。

sents.en: An add that no rule supports is residual under Add- ⊥ \bot .
sents.zh: 没有任何规则支持的加法操作在 Add- ⊥ \bot 下被视为剩余项。

paragraphs.en: A prune is supported only by evidence that excludes the target. Such evidence must come from the complement of a sound over-approximation : if a relation contains every function that may be written into a field, a function outside it is refuted ( Møller and Schwartzbach, 2026 ) . The complement of a relation that may have missed members refutes nothing, so an empty F ( S . m ) F(S{.}m) is no evidence of absence. Two rules satisfy this requirement without consulting the model.
paragraphs.zh: 只有排除目标目标的证据才能支持一个剪枝。 此类证据必须来自一个可靠的上近似补集：如果一个关系包含所有可能被写入字段的函数，那么该关系之外的函数即被证伪（Møller 和 Schwartzbach，2026）。 一个可能遗漏成员的关系的补集无法证伪任何内容，因此一个空的 F(S.m) 并非缺失的证据。 两条规则无需参考模型即可满足这一要求。

Its premise π sig \pi_{\mathrm{sig}} is well-typed dispatch: every target of c c has a signature compatible with the field’s. This is the typability assumption under which a points-to set may be filtered by type ( Møller and Schwartzbach, 2026 ) . By the definition of ∼ \sim , the refutation applies only to a return-type, arity, or concrete-pointer mismatch. Prune-Store refutes f f when F ( S . m ) F(S{.}m) is non-empty and omits f f . Its premise π proj \pi_{\mathrm{proj}} has two parts. First, the recovered field key ( S , m ) (S,m) is the field c c loads from, which § 4.2 measures against typed IR. Second, the projection is sound at that field: it missed no assignment, so F ∗ ( S . m ) ⊆ F ( S . m ) F^{*}(S{.}m)\subseteq F(S{.}m) ( Møller and Schwartzbach, 2026 ) . In the running example, the three sibling fields share one signature, so Prune-Sig separates none of their implementations. paragraphs.en: A model-proposed prune names no over-approximation and stays residual under Prune- ⊥ \bot . The rules leave two kinds of residual cases undecided: sites empty after the witnessed additions, and same-signature candidates that no warrant separates. Both kinds are resolved in § 3.4 .
paragraphs.zh: 模型提出的剪枝方法不会引入过度近似，并且在 Prune-⊥ \bot 下保持残差性。 这些规则留下了两种未决的残差情况：在已见证的添加操作之后为空的位置，以及没有证据能够区分的相同签名候选项。 这两种情况都在 § 3.4 中得到了解决。

sents.en: A model-proposed prune names no over-approximation and stays residual under Prune- ⊥ \bot .
sents.zh: 模型提出的剪枝方法不会引入过度近似，并且在 Prune-⊥ \bot 下保持残差性。

sents.en: The rules leave two kinds of residual cases undecided: sites empty after the witnessed additions, and same-signature candidates that no warrant separates.
sents.zh: 这些规则留下了两种未决的残差情况：在已见证的添加操作之后为空的位置，以及没有证据能够区分的相同签名候选项。

sents.en: Both kinds are resolved in § 3.4 .
sents.zh: 这两种情况都在 § 3.4 中得到了解决。

paragraphs.en: Candidates that share the field and the signature still differ only in their semantic role. This role can only be inferred from their names and implementations. An LLM can infer it, and a symbolic analysis cannot. Therefore, Facet resolves the residual cases neuro-symbolically: an LLM decides them, but only by selecting from a symbolically bounded candidate list . This restriction has three consequences. First, Add-Untaken rejects a proposal that names no address-taken function. Second, when the model gives no usable answer, the symbolic result is kept. Third, the rules of § 3.3 classify the model’s decisions like any other fact. Hence, a proposal that also names the field supplying the target receives the store warrant if F ( S . m ) F(S{.}m) holds that function at a compatible signature, with the named field as a further premise.
paragraphs.zh: 共享该字段和签名的候选项之间，仍然仅在其语义角色上存在差异。 这一角色只能通过它们的名称和实现来推断。 LLM 可以推断出这一点，而符号分析则无法做到。 因此，Facet 以神经-符号方式解决了剩余情况：由 LLM 做出决定，但仅能从符号上受限的候选项列表中选择一个结果。 这一限制有三个后果。 首先，Add-Untaken 会拒绝任何未指定已取地址函数的提案。 其次，当模型无法给出可用答案时，将保留符号分析的结果。 第三，§ 3.3 中的规则会将模型的决策像其他任何事实一样进行分类。 因此，如果 F(S{.}m) 在兼容的签名下对该函数成立，且以所命名的字段作为额外前提，那么一个同时指定了提供目标字段的提案将获得存储许可。

paragraphs.en: Completion is needed because no filter can populate an initially empty site: a prune-only resolver cannot exceed the recall of its input. For a site the witnesses leave empty, the model selects add targets from the address-taken functions of the site’s signature category. The reconstructed field serves as context rather than evidence: the query names it and asks for this field’s implementors, so the model rejects similarly named siblings.
paragraphs.zh: 之所以需要补全，是因为没有任何过滤器能够填充一个最初为空的位置：仅能修剪的解析器无法超越其输入的召回范围。 对于见证者留下的空位置，模型会从该位置签名类别的地址已取函数中选择添加目标。 重建后的字段充当上下文而非证据：查询会命名它并要求提供该字段的实现者，因此模型会拒绝名称相似的同类项。

paragraphs.en: At the same-signature residual cases, the candidate set is already symbolically bounded. Hence, a single prompt per site presents every candidate by its name and the beginning of its body, and asks for a keep-or-prune decision on each. Presenting the candidates together lets the model compare siblings rather than classify each one in isolation.
paragraphs.zh: 对于同签名残差情况，候选集已经具有符号性界限。 因此，每个站点只需一个提示，即可通过名称和正文开头展示每个候选体，并要求对每个候选体做出保留或剔除的决定。 同时展示候选体能让模型比较彼此之间的关系，而不是孤立地分类每一个候选体。

paragraphs.en: The refined call graph R ± R^{\pm} adopts residual facts and every warranted fact, including the premised ones, subject to two checks. Under precedence , the warranted decision is kept when a warranted rule and a model proposal disagree on an edge. Hence, a residual prune acts only on edges that no warrant supports. Under abstention , whether a change is adopted at all depends on the site, for warranted and residual changes alike. At an initially empty site, every recovered edge increases recall. At a site that the evidence has already narrowed to one or two targets, however, a change in either direction is more likely to harm than to help. The symbolic result at a site is R 0 R_{0} after the refutations of § 3.3.2 . Therefore, Facet abstains wherever the symbolic result is non-empty and holds at most τ \tau targets. With P sym ​ ( c ) P_{\mathrm{sym}}(c) the targets that Prune-Sig and Prune-Store refute at c c , the abstention set is 𝐴𝑏𝑠𝑡 = { c ∣ 0 < | R 0 ​ ( c ) ∖ P sym ​ ( c ) | ≤ τ } \mathit{Abst}=\{c\mid 0<|R_{0}(c)\setminus P_{\mathrm{sym}}(c)|\leq\tau\} . Such a site is returned as the symbolic analysis left it. No addition is adopted there, including warranted ones. The model’s removals are withdrawn, but warranted refutations stay. Changes apply to a copy of R 0 R_{0} , so classification does not depend on the order in which facts are adopted.
paragraphs.zh: 经过精修的调用图 R ± R^{\pm} 会采纳残余事实以及所有有充分依据的事实（包括前提事实），但需经过两项检查。 在优先顺序机制下，当一条有充分依据的规则与模型提案对某条边产生分歧时，仍保留该有充分依据的决策。 因此，残余剪枝仅作用于没有任何依据支持的边。 在弃权机制下，无论变更是有充分依据的还是残余的，是否采纳该变更都取决于具体位置。 在初始为空的位置中，每条恢复的边都会提高召回率。 然而，在证据已将目标范围缩小至一个或两个的位置中，任何方向的变更更可能带来负面影响而非帮助。 经过 §3.3.2 中的反驳后，某位置上的符号化结果为 R 0 R_{0}。 因此，只要符号化结果非空且最多包含 τ \tau 个目标，Facet 就会在该位置采取弃权。 设 P sym ​ ( c ) P_{\mathrm{sym}}(c) 为 Prune-Sig 和 Prune-Store 在 c c 处反驳的目标，则弃权集合为 𝐴𝑏𝑠𝑡 = { c ∣ 0 < | R 0 ​ ( c ) ∖ P sym ​ ( c ) | ≤ τ } \mathit{Abst}=\{c\mid 0<|R_{0}(c)\setminus P_{\mathrm{sym}}(c)|\leq\tau\}。 此类位置将按符号化分析的结果原样返回。 在这些位置中不会采纳任何新增内容，包括有充分依据的内容。 模型中的删除操作将被撤销，但有充分依据的反驳操作仍会保留。 变更应用于 R 0 R_{0} 的一个副本，因此分类结果不依赖于事实被采纳的顺序。

sents.en: At an initially empty site, every recovered edge increases recall.
sents.zh: 在初始为空的位置中，每条恢复的边都会提高召回率。

sents.en: At a site that the evidence has already narrowed to one or two targets, however, a change in either direction is more likely to harm than to help.
sents.zh: 然而，在证据已将目标范围缩小至一个或两个的位置中，任何方向的变更更可能带来负面影响而非帮助。

sents.en: The symbolic result at a site is R 0 R_{0} after the refutations of § 3.3.2 .
sents.zh: 经过 §3.3.2 中的反驳后，某位置上的符号化结果为 R 0 R_{0}。

sents.en: Therefore, Facet abstains wherever the symbolic result is non-empty and holds at most τ \tau targets.
sents.zh: 因此，只要符号化结果非空且最多包含 τ \tau 个目标，Facet 就会在该位置采取弃权。

sents.en: With P sym ​ ( c ) P_{\mathrm{sym}}(c) the targets that Prune-Sig and Prune-Store refute at c c , the abstention set is 𝐴𝑏𝑠𝑡 = { c ∣ 0 < | R 0 ​ ( c ) ∖ P sym ​ ( c ) | ≤ τ } \mathit{Abst}=\{c\mid 0<|R_{0}(c)\setminus P_{\mathrm{sym}}(c)|\leq\tau\} .
sents.zh: 设 P sym ​ ( c ) P_{\mathrm{sym}}(c) 为 Prune-Sig 和 Prune-Store 在 c c 处反驳的目标，则弃权集合为 𝐴𝑏𝑠𝑡 = { c ∣ 0 < | R 0 ​ ( c ) ∖ P sym ​ ( c ) | ≤ τ } \mathit{Abst}=\{c\mid 0<|R_{0}(c)\setminus P_{\mathrm{sym}}(c)|\leq\tau\}。

sents.en: Such a site is returned as the symbolic analysis left it.
sents.zh: 此类位置将按符号化分析的结果原样返回。

sents.en: No addition is adopted there, including warranted ones.
sents.zh: 在这些位置中不会采纳任何新增内容，包括有充分依据的内容。

sents.en: The model’s removals are withdrawn, but warranted refutations stay.
sents.zh: 模型中的删除操作将被撤销，但有充分依据的反驳操作仍会保留。

sents.en: Changes apply to a copy of R 0 R_{0} , so classification does not depend on the order in which facts are adopted.
sents.zh: 变更应用于 R 0 R_{0} 的一个副本，因此分类结果不依赖于事实被采纳的顺序。

paragraphs.en: Two call graphs are needed because reconstruction is not always complete. The projection can miss an assignment, and merging a type’s objects adds candidates. Hence, removing an edge on a premise or a model decision carries a risk that adding an edge does not. Separating the results that hold without an assumption from the rest follows the approach of defensive points-to analysis ( Smaragdakis and Kastrinis, 2018 ) . A client that must not lose an initial edge uses R + R^{+} , for example forward-edge CFI ( Abadi et al., 2005 ; Tice et al., 2014 ; Burow et al., 2017 ) or another soundness-sensitive analysis. A client that accepts a small recall risk for a smaller graph uses R ± R^{\pm} , for example bug detection ( Sui et al., 2012 ; Shi et al., 2018 ; Lu et al., 2019 ) , as call-graph pruning also does ( Utture et al., 2022 ; Le-Cong et al., 2022 ) . They differ only in which classified facts they adopt, so the choice costs a single analysis.
paragraphs.zh: 由于重构并不总是完整的，因此需要两个调用图。 投影可能会遗漏某个赋值，而合并一个类型的对象则会增加候选项。 因此，移除前提或模型决策中的一条边存在风险，而添加一条边则没有这种风险。 将无需假设即可成立的结果与其余结果分离的方法，遵循了防御性指针分析（Smaragdakis 和 Kastrinis，2018）的思路。 一个不能失去初始边的客户端使用 R + R^{+}，例如前向边 CFI（Abadi 等，2005；Tice 等，2014；Burow 等，2017）或其他对健全性敏感的分析方法。 一个愿意接受较低召回率以换取更小图的客户端使用 R ± R^{\pm}，例如错误检测（Sui 等，2012；Shi 等，2018；Lu 等，2019），调用图剪枝也采用这种方法（Utture 等，2022；Le-Cong 等，2022）。 它们唯一的区别在于采用了哪些分类事实，因此选择它们只需一次分析。

paragraphs.en: Our evaluation answers five research questions:
paragraphs.zh: 我们的评估回答了五个研究问题：

paragraphs.en: RQ1 (reconstruction): how much of the dispatch relation does Facet reconstruct from opaque IR, and how often does the recovered dispatched field agree with typed IR?
paragraphs.zh: 研究问题1（重建）：Facet 能从不透明的 IR 中重建多少比例的派发关系，以及恢复出的已派发字段与带类型标注的 IR 在多大程度上一致？

paragraphs.en: RQ2 (effectiveness): how much does the refined call graph improve precision and recall over the initial call graph?
paragraphs.zh: 研究问题2（有效性）：与初始调用图相比，优化后的调用图在精确率和召回率上分别提升了多少？

paragraphs.en: RQ3 (comparison): how does Facet compare with state-of-the-art icall analyses?
paragraphs.zh: 研究问题3（比较）：Facet 与当前最先进的 icall 分析方法相比表现如何？

paragraphs.en: RQ4 (ablation study): how much does each component of Facet contribute to the result?
paragraphs.zh: 研究问题4（消融研究）：Facet 的每个组件对结果有多大的贡献？

paragraphs.en: RQ5 (application): does an audit guided by the refined call graph find real defects?
paragraphs.zh: 问题5（应用）：由优化后的调用图指导的审计能否发现真实缺陷？

paragraphs.en: Facet consists of about 3,100 lines of C++ on SVF 3.3 and LLVM 21.1.0 and 3,700 lines of Python. It runs on whole-program bitcode extracted with gllvm ( SRI-CSL, 2026 ) . In every configuration, we key SVF’s field objects on opaque IR by base type and byte offset and count allocation wrappers as allocation sites. The residual cases of § 3.4 are decided by the oracle , Gemini 3.7 Flash at temperature 0. The abstention threshold of § 3.4.3 is τ = 2 \tau{=}2 . The prune stage skips 27 sites and records each as a residual: 23 dispatch through a table indexed at run time and four have no source position.
paragraphs.zh: Facet 包含约 3,100 行基于 SVF 3.3 和 LLVM 21.1.0 的 C++ 代码，以及 3,700 行 Python 代码。 它运行在通过 gllvm（SRI-CSL，2026）提取的全程序 bitcode 上。 在所有配置中，我们根据基础类型和字节偏移量，将 SVF 的字段对象与不透明的 IR 进行关联，并将分配包装器计为分配位置。 § 3.4 中的剩余情况由预言机 Gemini 3.7 Flash（温度设为 0）决定。 § 3.4.3 中的弃权阈值是 τ = 2 \tau{=}2。 剪枝阶段跳过了 27 个位置，并将每个位置记录为剩余项：其中 23 个通过运行时索引的表进行分发，另外 4 个没有源位置信息。

paragraphs.en: We use three metrics. The average number of targets per site is | R ⁡ ( c ) | |R(c)| averaged over the sites that a resolver reports ( Table 2 ). When a comparison is confined to the ground-truth sites, as in Figure 7 (b), the average is taken over those sites. Following prior work ( Lu and Hu, 2019 ; Cai et al., 2024 ) , it measures precision without ground truth. Table 2 also reports, as Ratio , the R 0 R_{0} mean over Facet ’s. In every table, a darker cell is better within its column. The four target columns of Table 2 are shaded on a logarithmic scale, and the four F1 columns of Table 6 share one scale. paragraphs.en: We compare against four groups of baselines. Symbolic : Andersen’s analysis, and the initial call graph R 0 R_{0} that it induces under FLTA (§ 3.2 ). paragraphs.en: We select 14 C programs from the OSS-Fuzz projects; Table 1 lists them, abbreviating libjpeg-turbo as libjpeg-tb . They range from the 12 KLoC Markdown parser md4c to the 620 KLoC dovecot . Following SEA ( Cheng et al., 2024 ) , we build the ground truth (GT) by instrumenting each subject and running its test suite or a realistic workload; the log is matched to the analyzed IR, so both agree on call sites. Only observed sites are scored; Table 1 reports their share as cov , and the reference is a lower bound on the true targets (§ 5.2 ). All experiments run on a machine with two Intel Xeon Gold 6248 processors and 188 GB RAM.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从 OSS-Fuzz 项目中选择了 14 个 C 程序；表 1 列出了这些程序，其中 libjpeg-turbo 简写为 libjpeg-tb。 它们的代码规模从 12 KLoC 的 Markdown 解析器 md4c 到 620 KLoC 的 dovecot 不等。 遵循 SEA（Cheng 等人，2024）的方法，我们通过为每个被测程序添加插装代码并运行其测试套件或真实工作负载来构建基准真相（GT）；日志与经过分析的代表性中间表示（IR）进行匹配，因此两者在调用位置上一致。 仅对观察到的调用位置进行评分；表 1 报告了这些位置的比例 cov，而参考值则是真实目标的下界（§5.2）。 所有实验均在一台配备两个 Intel Xeon Gold 6248 处理器和 188 GB RAM 的机器上运行。

paragraphs.en: No ground truth exists for 𝑑𝑖𝑠𝑝 ⁡ ( c ) \mathit{disp}(c) : the dynamic reference records which functions a site called and nothing about the field. Prior analyses do not measure this intermediate either: type-based tools report the target sets they produce ( Lu and Hu, 2019 ; Xia et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2025b ) , and TypeCopilot measures the accuracy of its recovered types rather than of the dispatched field ( Zhou et al., 2025 ) . Hence, we check the recovered field against typed IR, a reference that the reconstruction never consults. On LLVM 14 typed-pointer IR, the address computation that feeds the callee load still contains the struct type and field index that opaque IR erases. We rebuild all 14 subjects under LLVM 14 and disassemble them with LLVM 14 tools, since a newer disassembler would upgrade the types. We extract each icall ’s dispatched field from that computation wherever it names a field of a named struct. We match sites to the opaque-IR analysis by file, line, and column, and by inlining chain for inlined calls. Thus, the typed-IR field comes from the IR types and the recovered field from the DWARF layout and byte offset. The debug information serves the typed-IR extraction only to turn a field index into a name.
paragraphs.zh: 𝑑𝑖𝑠𝑝 ⁡ ( c ) \mathit{disp}(c) 没有基准事实：动态引用记录了一个站点调用了哪些函数，但并未说明该字段的情况。 先前的分析也没有测量这一中间环节：基于类型的工具报告它们生成的目标集合（Lu 和 Hu, 2019；Xia 等人, 2024；Li 等人, 2025b），而 TypeCopilot 测量的是其恢复的类型而非所调用的字段的准确性（Zhou 等人, 2025）。 因此，我们将恢复的字段与带类型的 IR 进行比对，而重建过程从未参考过这一基准。 在 LLVM 14 的带类型指针的 IR 中，为被调用函数加载提供输入的地址计算仍然包含结构体类型和字段索引，而这些信息在不透明 IR 中已被删除。 我们在 LLVM 14 下重新构建全部 14 个测试用例，并使用 LLVM 14 工具对其反汇编，因为更新的反汇编器会升级类型。 每当 icall 的地址计算涉及某个命名结构体的字段时，我们都会从中提取其调用的字段。 我们通过文件、行和列，以及内联调用的内联链，将站点与不透明 IR 分析进行匹配。 因此，带类型 IR 的字段来自 IR 类型，而恢复的字段则来自 DWARF 布局和字节偏移量。 调试信息仅用于从字段索引中提取名称，从而辅助带类型 IR 的提取过程。

sents.en: No ground truth exists for 𝑑𝑖𝑠𝑝 ⁡ ( c ) \mathit{disp}(c) : the dynamic reference records which functions a site called and nothing about the field.

sents.zh: 先前的分析也没有测量这一中间环节：基于类型的工具报告它们生成的目标集合（Lu 和 Hu, 2019；Xia 等人, 2024；Li 等人, 2025b），而 TypeCopilot 测量的是其恢复的类型而非所调用的字段的准确性（Zhou 等人, 2025）。

sents.en: Hence, we check the recovered field against typed IR, a reference that the reconstruction never consults.
sents.zh: 因此，我们将恢复的字段与带类型的 IR 进行比对，而重建过程从未参考过这一基准。

sents.en: On LLVM 14 typed-pointer IR, the address computation that feeds the callee load still contains the struct type and field index that opaque IR erases.
sents.zh: 在 LLVM 14 的带类型指针的 IR 中，为被调用函数加载提供输入的地址计算仍然包含结构体类型和字段索引，而这些信息在不透明 IR 中已被删除。

sents.en: We rebuild all 14 subjects under LLVM 14 and disassemble them with LLVM 14 tools, since a newer disassembler would upgrade the types.
sents.zh: 我们在 LLVM 14 下重新构建全部 14 个测试用例，并使用 LLVM 14 工具对其反汇编，因为更新的反汇编器会升级类型。

sents.en: We extract each icall ’s dispatched field from that computation wherever it names a field of a named struct.
sents.zh: 每当 icall 的地址计算涉及某个命名结构体的字段时，我们都会从中提取其调用的字段。

sents.en: We match sites to the opaque-IR analysis by file, line, and column, and by inlining chain for inlined calls.
sents.zh: 我们通过文件、行和列，以及内联调用的内联链，将站点与不透明 IR 分析进行匹配。

sents.en: Thus, the typed-IR field comes from the IR types and the recovered field from the DWARF layout and byte offset.
sents.zh: 因此，带类型 IR 的字段来自 IR 类型，而恢复的字段则来自 DWARF 布局和字节偏移量。

sents.en: The debug information serves the typed-IR extraction only to turn a field index into a name.
sents.zh: 调试信息仅用于从字段索引中提取名称，从而辅助带类型 IR 的提取过程。

paragraphs.en: Typed IR exposes such a field at 1,586 1{,}586 sites. The reconstruction reports a field at 1,550 1{,}550 of them ( 97.7 % 97.7\% ). Of these, 1,520 1{,}520 ( 98.1 % 98.1\% ) agree on the field, and 1,516 1{,}516 ( 97.8 % 97.8\% ) agree on both struct and field. Of the 30 30 disagreements, 25 25 are in dovecot and redis . Four of these, at redis ’s config.c , dispatch through a union and differ only in which union member names the location. The one disagreement in lua is an error in the typed-IR extraction.
paragraphs.zh: 类型化 IR 在 1,586 个位置暴露了这样一个字段。 重建结果报告称其中 1,550 个位置存在该字段（97.7%）。 在这些位置中，有 1,520 个（98.1%）对字段达成一致，而 1,516 个（97.8%）对结构和字段都达成一致。 在 30 处不一致中，有 25 处位于 dovecot 和 redis 中。 其中四处位于 redis 的 config.c 文件中，通过一个联合体进行分发，仅在于哪个联合体成员命名了该位置。 lua 中的那处不一致是类型化 IR 提取过程中的错误。

paragraphs.en: Over-approximated sites. Table 2 measures the repair at these sites by how many targets remain, which needs no ground truth. paragraphs.en: Precision and recall. Against the dynamic reference, the refined nginx graph reaches precision 0.377 0.377 , recall 0.956 0.956 , and F1 0.457 0.457 , up from R 0 R_{0} ’s F1 of 0.080 0.080 . Across the 14 subjects, macro F1 rises from 0.406 0.406 to 0.702 0.702 and recall from 0.786 0.786 to 0.986 0.986 . The absolute F1 stays low because precision is bounded by the edges of R 0 R_{0} that no warrant refutes, which we examine below. As Figure 7 (c, d) shows, the gain concentrates where type erasure breaks dispatch. The 1,105 struct-field sites among the 1,843 gain 0.347 0.347 precision and 0.293 0.293 recall. The 544 global -pointer sites are already precise and gain about a third as much, and the 13 array-indexed sites gain as well. Even the 181 sites with no recovered field gain precision, at a 0.006 0.006 recall cost.
paragraphs.zh: 精确率和召回率。 与动态参考相比，优化后的 nginx 图的精确率达到 0.377 0.377，召回率为 0.956 0.956，F1 为 0.457 0.457，高于 R₀ 的 F1 值 0.080 0.080。 在 14 个测试用例中，宏 F1 从 0.406 0.406 提升至 0.702 0.702，召回率从 0.786 0.786 提升至 0.986 0.986。 绝对 F1 值仍然较低，因为精确率受到 R₀ 中那些没有反证依据的边的限制，我们将在下文对此进行探讨。 如图 7（c、d）所示，增益主要集中在类型擦除破坏分发的位置。 在 1,843 个结构体字段位置中，有 1,105 个获得了 0.347 0.347 的精确率和 0.293 0.293 的召回率。 544 个全局指针位置的精确率已经很高，增益约为其值的三分之一；13 个数组索引位置也获得了增益。 即使那些没有恢复字段的 181 个位置，其精确率也有所提升，但代价是召回率下降了 0.006 0.006。

paragraphs.en: The gain rarely harms a site: F1 improves at 935 935 of the 1,843 1{,}843 ground-truth sites, is unchanged at 891 891 , and worsens at 17 17 . paragraphs.en: Unobserved edges. The ground truth is a lower bound on the true targets, so an edge it does not observe is not necessarily wrong. Hence, we examine the static evidence behind each such edge. The refined call graph reports 9,497 9{,}497 edges at ground-truth sites, of which 3,173 3{,}173 are observed. None of the other 6,324 6{,}324 contradicts the analysis: each matches the dispatched field’s signature and, where the store set is non-empty, is stored into that field. 18.1 % 18.1\% of them (1,146/6,324) name a function that the workload dispatched at another site. The rest concentrate where the store set merges objects: run-time-assigned fields carry 4.8 4.8 unrefuted edges per observed edge, against 0.8 0.8 for static tables.

paragraphs.en: To rule out that Facet ’s margin comes only from the type-based tools running without their types, we further examine two settings in which those tools have the types. Type analysis on typed IR gives these tools the types directly. On the LLVM 14 typed-pointer rebuilds, MLTA reaches macro F1 0.491 0.491 , KallGraph 0.509 0.509 , and TFA 0.488 0.488 . All three fall below Facet ’s 0.702 0.702 on opaque IR. On nginx , typed-IR MLTA still misses 220 220 targets that Facet recovers, and an initializer witnesses 192 192 of them. Hence, what MLTA lacks is the evidence of which functions the program assigns to the field. Recovered types on opaque IR test whether re-inferring the types on opaque IR recovers even that much. TypeCopilot ( Zhou et al., 2025 ) ’s multi-layer mode scores macro F1 0.373 0.373 , below the 0.491 0.491 of MLTA on typed IR. Its released configuration scores 0.050 0.050 , because matching on type sets leaves most sites empty. Therefore, recovering the types restores at most what typed IR supports, and the margin above that comes from the assignment relation.
paragraphs.zh: 为了排除 Facet 的增益仅源于无需类型即可运行的基于类型的工具这一可能性，我们进一步研究了两种这些工具具备类型的设置。 对带类型信息的 IR 进行类型分析，可以直接为这些工具提供类型信息。 在 LLVM 14 的带类型指针的重建测试中，MLTA 的宏观 F1 值为 0.491 0.491，KallGraph 为 0.509 0.509，TFA 为 0.488 0.488。 这三种方法在不透明 IR 上的表现均低于 Facet 的 0.702 0.702。 在 nginx 上，使用带类型信息的 IR 的 MLTA 仍然遗漏了 220 220 个 Facet 能够恢复的目标，而一个初始化器检测到了其中 192 192 个。 因此，MLTA 所缺乏的是程序将哪些函数分配给字段的证据。 在不透明 IR 上恢复类型可以测试，重新推断不透明 IR 上的类型是否至少能恢复如此多的目标。 TypeCopilot（Zhou 等人，2025）的多层模式得分的宏观 F1 值为 0.373 0.373，低于 MLTA 在带类型信息的 IR 上取得的 0.491 0.491。 其发布配置得分仅为 0.050 0.050，因为基于类型集的匹配导致大多数位置为空。 因此，恢复类型最多只能还原带类型信息的 IR 所支持的部分，而超出该部分的增益则来自分配关系。

paragraphs.en: The LLM-based analysis SEA ( Cheng et al., 2024 ) reaches macro F1 0.312 0.312 under the Gemini model that we use and SEA’s documented five-vote protocol. SEA reports targets by definition site, so Table 4 leaves its per-site columns blank. Most of the gap arises before the model is queried, because SEA only filters the candidates of its parser. paragraphs.en: Finally, as Figure 8 a shows, all four resolvers recover 2,097 2{,}097 of the 3,286 3{,}286 observed edges. Facet alone recovers 49 49 edges, against 5 5 for KallGraph alone, 1 1 for TypeCopilot alone, and none for MLTA alone. TFA recovers no edge that the other four miss. Only Facet and TypeCopilot recover 433 433 edges. However, TypeCopilot reports 36.1 36.1 targets per site, against 7.9 7.9 for Facet . Of the 433 433 , 397 397 lie at the 398 398 expansion sites of redis ’s REDISMODULE_GET_API macro. Without these sites, Facet ’s macro F1 is 0.684 0.684 and still exceeds KallGraph’s 0.533 0.533 . Of the 113 113 observed edges Facet misses, 95 95 are absent from R 0 R_{0} and 5 5 are removed by a warrant. KallGraph traces a function through the objects it is stored into until the function reaches the call. Hence, it keeps objects apart, but it leaves a site empty wherever it fails to track the pointer: 606 606 sites, against 16 16 for Facet . Facet instead joins on the field key, which needs no end-to-end trace but merges all objects of one type. KallGraph reports fewer targets at 218 218 sites. Accordingly, 179 179 of them dispatch through run-time-assigned fields whose objects KallGraph separates and Facet merges. As Figure 8 b shows, this merging reduces precision. Facet reports 3,144 3{,}144 unobserved edges that KallGraph does not, against 1,076 1{,}076 in the opposite direction. Hence, each of the 673 673 observed edges that only Facet recovers comes with 4.7 4.7 unobserved edges, and each of KallGraph’s 83 83 comes with 13 13 . Hence, Facet is more complete where value flow is lost, and KallGraph more precise where object flow is traceable.
paragraphs.zh: 最后，如图 8a 所示，所有四个智能体都恢复了观测到的 3,286 条边中的 2,097 条。 Facet 单独恢复了 49 条边，而 KallGraph 单独仅恢复 5 条，TypeCopilot 单独恢复 1 条，MLTA 单独则未恢复任何一条。 TFA 没有恢复其他四个智能体遗漏的任何一条边。 只有 Facet 和 TypeCopilot 恢复了 433 条边。 然而，TypeCopilot 报告的每个站点目标数为 36.1，而 Facet 为 7.9。 在这 433 条边中，有 397 条位于 redis 的 REDISMODULE_GET_API 宏的 398 个扩展站点上。 如果没有这些站点，Facet 的宏 F1 为 0.684，仍然高于 KallGraph 的 0.533。 在 Facet 遗漏的 113 条观测边中，有 95 条不在 R₀ 中，另有 5 条被一个授权移除。 KallGraph 会沿着函数被存储到的对象进行追溯，直到该函数到达调用处。 因此，它会将对象分开处理，但在无法追踪指针的地方，站点会被留空：共有 606 个站点，而 Facet 仅为 16 个。 相比之下，Facet 则基于字段键进行连接，这无需端到端的追溯，但会合并同一类型的所有对象。 KallGraph 报告的站点目标数较少，为 218 个。 相应地，其中 179 个目标通过运行时分配的字段进行分发，这些对象的 KallGraph 会分开处理，而 Facet 则会合并。 如图 8b 所示，这种合并会降低精确度。 Facet 报告了 3,144 条未被观测到的边，而 KallGraph 没有报告这些边；相反方向则有 1,076 条。 因此，在仅由 Facet 恢复的 673 条观测边中，每条边都伴随着 4.7 条未被观测到的边；而在 KallGraph 报告的 83 条观测边中，每条边则伴随着 13 条。 因此，在值流丢失的情况下，Facet 的完整性更高；而在对象流可追溯的情况下，KallGraph 的精确度更高。

sents.zh: 如果没有这些站点，Facet 的宏 F1 为 0.684，仍然高于 KallGraph 的 0.533。

sents.en: Of the 113 113 observed edges Facet misses, 95 95 are absent from R 0 R_{0} and 5 5 are removed by a warrant.
sents.zh: 在 Facet 遗漏的 113 条观测边中，有 95 条不在 R₀ 中，另有 5 条被一个授权移除。

sents.en: KallGraph traces a function through the objects it is stored into until the function reaches the call.
sents.zh: KallGraph 会沿着函数被存储到的对象进行追溯，直到该函数到达调用处。

sents.en: Hence, it keeps objects apart, but it leaves a site empty wherever it fails to track the pointer: 606 606 sites, against 16 16 for Facet .
sents.zh: 因此，它会将对象分开处理，但在无法追踪指针的地方，站点会被留空：共有 606 个站点，而 Facet 仅为 16 个。

sents.en: Facet instead joins on the field key, which needs no end-to-end trace but merges all objects of one type.
sents.zh: 相比之下，Facet 则基于字段键进行连接，这无需端到端的追溯，但会合并同一类型的所有对象。

sents.en: KallGraph reports fewer targets at 218 218 sites.
sents.zh: KallGraph 报告的站点目标数较少，为 218 个。

sents.en: Accordingly, 179 179 of them dispatch through run-time-assigned fields whose objects KallGraph separates and Facet merges.
sents.zh: 相应地，其中 179 个目标通过运行时分配的字段进行分发，这些对象的 KallGraph 会分开处理，而 Facet 则会合并。

sents.en: As Figure 8 b shows, this merging reduces precision.
sents.zh: 如图 8b 所示，这种合并会降低精确度。

sents.en: Facet reports 3,144 3{,}144 unobserved edges that KallGraph does not, against 1,076 1{,}076 in the opposite direction.
sents.zh: Facet 报告了 3,144 条未被观测到的边，而 KallGraph 没有报告这些边；相反方向则有 1,076 条。

sents.en: Hence, each of the 673 673 observed edges that only Facet recovers comes with 4.7 4.7 unobserved edges, and each of KallGraph’s 83 83 comes with 13 13 .
sents.zh: 因此，在仅由 Facet 恢复的 673 条观测边中，每条边都伴随着 4.7 条未被观测到的边；而在 KallGraph 报告的 83 条观测边中，每条边则伴随着 13 条。

sents.en: Hence, Facet is more complete where value flow is lost, and KallGraph more precise where object flow is traceable.
sents.zh: 因此，在值流丢失的情况下，Facet 的完整性更高；而在对象流可追溯的情况下，KallGraph 的精确度更高。

paragraphs.en: As Table 4 shows, the symbolic and neural parts of Facet fail differently on their own. Facet w/o LLM separates the symbolic components of § 3.2 and § 3.3 from the neural one of § 3.4 and leaves every other stage in place. The symbolic part alone reaches macro F1 0.636 0.636 , above every prior tool. However, it leaves 116 116 ground-truth sites empty and 14.8 14.8 targets per site, because a warrant can act only where the program supplies evidence. An LLM alone, as SEA uses it, reaches 0.312 0.312 under the same model. Together they reach 0.702 0.702 : the model resolves 100 100 of the 116 116 empty sites, halves the target set to 7.9 7.9 , and removes 69 % 69\% of the remaining unobserved edges. Meanwhile, the warrants keep the model’s task small and its answer bounded. Macro F1 understates this division, because residual sites are a minority by construction. The 0.066 0.066 that the model adds is 22 % 22\% of the gain over R 0 R_{0} , and the symbolic 78 % 78\% makes the result robust to the choice of model.
paragraphs.zh: 如表 4 所示，Facet 的符号部分和神经部分各自运行时表现出的失败方式不同。 不含 LLM 的 Facet 将 § 3.2 和 § 3.3 中的符号组件与 § 3.4 中的神经组件分离，同时保留其余所有阶段不变。 仅靠符号部分就达到了宏观 F1 值 0.636 0.636，高于此前所有工具。 然而，它留下了 116 116 个真实标注的空白位置以及每个位置 14.8 14.8 个目标，因为令状只能在程序提供证据的地方生效。 仅使用 LLM（如 SEA 所用），在相同模型下只能达到 0.312 0.312。 两者结合后达到了 0.702 0.702：该模型解决了 116 116 个空白位置中的 100 100 个，将目标集减少到 7.9 7.9，并移除了剩余未观测边中的 69 % 69\%。 与此同时，令状使模型的任务保持简单，其答案也处于有限范围内。 宏观 F1 低估了这种分工，因为根据构造，剩余位置本身属于少数。 模型新增的 0.066 0.066 是相对于 R 0 R_{0} 提升量的 22 % 22\%，而符号部分贡献的 78 % 78\% 使结果对模型选择具有鲁棒性。

paragraphs.en: As Figure 7 (b) shows, the prune warrants narrow the target set at a small recall cost. Prune-Sig halves it, from 32.3 32.3 to 15.8 15.8 targets per ground-truth site, without losing recall on any subject. Prune-Store narrows it by a similar amount, to 16.0 16.0 , and the two rules together reach 14.4 14.4 . Prune-Store loses four observed edges on three subjects, at most 0.025 0.025 recall on gdbm . Each lost edge comes from a store that the projection cannot attribute to a field: a literal aggregate, a call result, or an array-element temporary. Admitting such stores by signature alone would recover all four at 0.1 0.1 more targets per site, but Facet does not admit them. On nginx , the two rules also lower F1 from 0.472 0.472 without them to 0.457 0.457 ( Table 3 ). Both rules rest on premises, so R + R^{+} uses neither; R ± R^{\pm} admits them because their recall cost is bounded. The add warrants supply most of the recovered recall. On nginx , the witnesses alone raise the recovered observed edges from 183 183 to 397 397 , close to the 400 400 of the full analysis. Over the 14 subjects, they add 628 628 observed edges, against 118 118 from the oracle. Witness-only reaches recall 0.960 0.960 , above the refined call graph’s 0.956 0.956 , because it never prunes.
paragraphs.zh: 如图 7 (b) 所示，剪枝依据以较小的召回率代价缩小了目标集。 Prune-Sig 将其减半，从每个真实站点 32.3 个目标减少到 15.8 个，且未在任何受试者上损失召回率。 Prune-Store 也以类似幅度将其缩小至 16.0 个，而两种规则结合使用时可达 14.4 个。 Prune-Store 在三个受试者上损失了四条观测到的边，在 gdbm 上的召回率最多损失 0.025。 每条损失的边都源于一个投影无法归因到任何字段的存储：一个字面聚合、一个调用结果或一个数组元素临时变量。 仅通过签名允许此类存储将恢复全部四条边，但每个站点需额外增加 0.1 个目标，而 Facet 并未允许它们。 在 nginx 上，两种规则还将 F1 值从不使用它们时的 0.472 降至 0.457（见表 3）。 两种规则都基于前提，因此 R + R^{+} 未使用任何前提；R ± R^{\pm} 允许它们，因为其召回率代价是有界的。 add 依据提供了大部分恢复的召回率。 在 nginx 上，仅凭见证者就将恢复的观测边从 183 条提升至 397 条，接近完整分析的 400 条。 在 14 个受试者中，它们增加了 628 条观测边，而来自 oracle 的仅有 118 条。 仅使用见证者的方法达到了 0.960 的召回率，高于精炼调用图的 0.956，因为它从未进行剪枝。

sents.zh: 如图 7 (b) 所示，剪枝依据以较小的召回率代价缩小了目标集。

sents.zh: 在 nginx 上，两种规则还将 F1 值从不使用它们时的 0.472 降至 0.457（见表 3）。

paragraphs.en: The oracle increases the recovered observed edges from 3,068 to 3,173. It reduces the unobserved edges from 20,250 to 6,324 and the empty ground-truth sites from 116 to 16. It improves per-site F1 at 198 sites and worsens it at 11. Gains are largest without field evidence ( sudo : F1 0.557 to 0.962) and negligible where witnesses suffice ( oniguruma : 0.988 to 0.989; md4c : unchanged). For additions, the oracle is queried only where witnesses leave a site empty and is the sole source at 108 sites across the 14 subjects. On nginx , it resolves the four remaining sites from 7.2 candidates each, versus 149 from signature matching. Two checks constrain the changes. Precedence prioritizes warranted decisions over model proposals. Disabling it lowers the refined graph’s recall below that of R + R^{+} on four subjects, and macro-averaging hides this regression. Abstention blocks changes at 609 sites with one or two symbolic targets, withholding 949 witness additions and 205 model removals. Among the 335 ground-truth sites in this group, only 9 of the 430 withheld additions were observed, whereas 19 of the 21 blocked removals would have deleted observed edges. Replaying the provenance with τ \tau from 1 to 4 changes macro F1 by at most 0.003 0.003 . Disabling abstention lowers macro F1 by 0.031 0.031 .
paragraphs.zh: 该预言机将已恢复的观测边数量从 3,068 增加至 3,173。 它将未观测边的数量从 20,250 减少至 6,324，并将空真实值站点数量从 116 减少至 16。 它在 198 个站点上提升了每个站点的 F1 值，但在 11 个站点上使其恶化。 在没有现场证据时，改进效果最大（sudo：F1 从 0.557 提升至 0.962）；而在见证者充足时，改进可忽略不计（oniguruma：从 0.988 提升至 0.989；md4c：无变化）。 对于新增项，仅在见证者使某个站点为空时才会查询该预言机，并且在 14 个受试者的 108 个站点中，它是最唯一的信息来源。 在 nginx 上，它能从每个站点的 7.2 个候选项中确定剩余的四个站点，而通过签名匹配则需要 149 个候选项。 两项检查对变化进行了约束。 优先原则使有依据的决策优于模型提案。 禁用该原则后，优化后的图的召回率会低于 R + R^{+} 在四个受试者上的召回率，而宏平均会掩盖这种性能下降。 弃权机制阻止了 609 个站点（其中包含一个或两个符号目标）的变化，并保留了 949 次见证者添加和 205 次模型移除。 在该组 335 个真实值站点中，被保留的 430 次添加中仅有 9 次被观测到；而被阻止的 21 次移除中有 19 次本会删除已观测到的边。 将溯源信息中的 τ \tau 从 1 更改至 4，宏 F1 的变化最多不超过 0.003 0.003。 禁用弃权机制会使宏 F1 下降 0.031 0.031。

sents.en: The oracle increases the recovered observed edges from 3,068 to 3,173.
sents.zh: 该预言机将已恢复的观测边数量从 3,068 增加至 3,173。

sents.en: It reduces the unobserved edges from 20,250 to 6,324 and the empty ground-truth sites from 116 to 16.
sents.zh: 它将未观测边的数量从 20,250 减少至 6,324，并将空真实值站点数量从 116 减少至 16。

sents.en: It improves per-site F1 at 198 sites and worsens it at 11.
sents.zh: 它在 198 个站点上提升了每个站点的 F1 值，但在 11 个站点上使其恶化。

sents.en: Gains are largest without field evidence ( sudo : F1 0.557 to 0.962) and negligible where witnesses suffice ( oniguruma : 0.988 to 0.989; md4c : unchanged).
sents.zh: 在没有现场证据时，改进效果最大（sudo：F1 从 0.557 提升至 0.962）；而在见证者充足时，改进可忽略不计（oniguruma：从 0.988 提升至 0.989；md4c：无变化）。

sents.zh: 在 nginx 上，它能从每个站点的 7.2 个候选项中确定剩余的四个站点，而通过签名匹配则需要 149 个候选项。

sents.zh: 两项检查对变化进行了约束。

sents.en: Precedence prioritizes warranted decisions over model proposals.
sents.zh: 优先原则使有依据的决策优于模型提案。

sents.zh: 禁用该原则后，优化后的图的召回率会低于 R + R^{+} 在四个受试者上的召回率，而宏平均会掩盖这种性能下降。

sents.en: Abstention blocks changes at 609 sites with one or two symbolic targets, withholding 949 witness additions and 205 model removals.
sents.zh: 弃权机制阻止了 609 个站点（其中包含一个或两个符号目标）的变化，并保留了 949 次见证者添加和 205 次模型移除。

sents.en: Among the 335 ground-truth sites in this group, only 9 of the 430 withheld additions were observed, whereas 19 of the 21 blocked removals would have deleted observed edges.
sents.zh: 在该组 335 个真实值站点中，被保留的 430 次添加中仅有 9 次被观测到；而被阻止的 21 次移除中有 19 次本会删除已观测到的边。

sents.zh: 将溯源信息中的 τ \tau 从 1 更改至 4，宏 F1 的变化最多不超过 0.003 0.003。

sents.en: Disabling abstention lowers macro F1 by 0.031 0.031 .
sents.zh: 禁用弃权机制会使宏 F1 下降 0.031 0.031。

paragraphs.en: Scoring the Two Call Graphs. Table 3 scores the same classified facts in both call graphs on nginx . R + R^{+} adopts only the 326 initializer-witnessed add facts and leaves R 0 R_{0} ’s spurious edges untouched. R ± R^{\pm} also accepts the premised warrants and the residual facts, and precedence retains every warranted edge. Dropping the residual add facts from the provenance gives precision 0.361 0.361 , recall 0.939 0.939 , and F1 0.441 0.441 . Compared with R + R^{+} ’s precision of 0.224 0.224 , the premised warrants account for the precision gain. Compared with R ± R^{\pm} ’s recall of 0.956 0.956 , the residual additions account for the remaining recall. Across the 14 subjects, R + R^{+} adds 2,745 2{,}745 edges and removes none; 452 452 of them are ground-truth edges that R 0 R_{0} missed. At ground-truth sites, 37.6 % 37.6\% of the initializer-witnessed additions are observed (452/1,203), against 9.1 % 9.1\% of the store-witnessed (176/1,937).
paragraphs.zh: 对两个调用图进行评分。 表 3 对 nginx 中两个调用图内相同的分类事实进行了评分。 R + R^{+} 仅采用由初始化器见证的 326 个添加事实，并保留 R 0 R_{0} 中的虚假边不变。 R ± R^{\pm} 还接受前提保障和剩余事实，且优先顺序保留了所有有保障的边。 从来源中移除剩余的添加事实后，精确度为 0.361 0.361，召回率为 0.939 0.939，F1 值为 0.441 0.441。 与 R + R^{+} 的精确度 0.224 0.224 相比，前提保障是精确度提升的原因。 与 R ± R^{\pm} 的召回率 0.956 0.956 相比，剩余的添加项解释了其余的召回率。 在 14 个主题中，R + R^{+} 添加了 2,745 2{,}745 条边且未移除任何边；其中 452 452 条是 R 0 R_{0} 遗漏的真实边。 在真实位置处，由初始化器见证的添加项中观察到 37.6 % 37.6\%（452/1,203），而由存储见证的添加项中仅观察到 9.1 % 9.1\%（176/1,937）。

paragraphs.en: Model Sensitivity. As Table 6 shows, we repeat the analysis under three models: Gemini 2.5 Flash ( Gemini Team, 2025 ) , Gemini 3.7 Flash, and GLM-5.3 ( Z.ai, 2026 ) from a second vendor. R + R^{+} is identical under all three, because it admits no LLM decision. The refined call graph’s macro F1 is 0.683 0.683 , 0.702 0.702 , and 0.708 0.708 under the three models. This span of 0.025 0.025 compares with a gap of 0.296 0.296 between the refined call graph and R 0 R_{0} ( Table 4 ). The widest per-subject span is 0.059 0.059 , on nginx . Equal scores do not imply equal decisions: on oniguruma , the three models propose 1,683 1{,}683 , 1,994 1{,}994 , and 2,071 2{,}071 prune facts but score identically, because a residual prune acts only on edges that no warrant covers (§ 3.4.3 ). The three models differ more in cost than in result. The same analysis costs $33.9 under Gemini 3.7 Flash (§ 4.3 ) and $236.7 under GLM-5.3, because GLM-5.3 produces long reasoning traces: 11,189 11{,}189 completion tokens per query on average, against 1,129 1{,}129 for Gemini.

paragraphs.en: Table 6 lists the 17 bugs that the refined call graph helped find across the 14 subjects and the Linux kernel. The call graph enables an audit that no per-function check can perform. The audit starts from the sites that R 0 R_{0} leaves empty and the refined call graph resolves. R 0 R_{0} leaves 20.7 % 20.7\% of the ground-truth sites empty (381/1,843). At each audited site, we derive from the caller the contract that every target must satisfy, and we inspect the implementation that disagrees with its siblings. We reported each bug upstream with a fix, and seven of these reports went through private responsible disclosure. Maintainers have confirmed 12 of the 17 so far.
paragraphs.zh: 表 6 列出了通过优化后的调用图在 14 个测试对象和 Linux 内核中帮助发现的 17 个错误。 调用图使得一种任何单函数检查都无法执行的审计成为可能。 该审计从 R 0 R_{0} 留空且经优化后的调用图能够确定的位置开始。 R 0 R_{0} 将真实数据中 20.7%（即 381/1,843）的位置留空。 在每个经过审计的位置，我们从调用者推导出所有目标必须满足的契约，并检查与其兄弟节点不一致的实现。 我们已向上游报告了每个错误并提供了修复方案，其中七份报告通过私下责任披露渠道提交。 截至目前，维护人员已确认这 17 个错误中的 12 个。

paragraphs.en: libjpeg-turbo illustrates the audit in . The decompressor dispatches upsampling through the _upsample field of jpeg_upsampler at line 2. The object comes from the library’s memory manager and the field is set by runtime stores at lines 5–7, so R 0 R_{0} and R + R^{+} resolve nothing here. The refined call graph resolves exactly the three stored implementations under the runtime-store warrant. Their caller, jpeg_skip_scanlines() , determines the contract: after a skip, the next delivered row is the first row after it. The implementations disagree at the early return of line 11 when a skip does not start on a row-group boundary. Then either a row from before the skip is delivered, or rows_to_go is unchanged and decoding runs past output_height into the caller’s buffer. Across 71,040 decodes, 883 outputs were wrong and nine hung (details in issue #915).
paragraphs.zh: libjpeg-turbo 在 . 中展示了此次审计。 解压器通过 jpeg_upsampler 的 _upsample 字段，在第 2 行执行上采样调度。 该对象来自库的内存管理器，而该字段由运行时存储在第 5–7 行设置，因此 R 0 R_{0} 和 R + R^{+} 在此处无法确定任何结果。 经过优化的调用图在运行时存储的授权下，精确确定了三个已存储的实现。 它们的调用者 jpeg_skip_scanlines() 决定了契约：跳过之后，下一个交付的行是紧随其后的第一行。 当跳过操作未从行组边界开始时，这些实现在第 11 行的提前返回处存在分歧。 此时，要么在跳过之前的某一行被交付，要么 rows_to_go 保持不变，解码过程会越过 output_height，进入调用者的缓冲区。 在 71,040 次解码中，有 883 个输出错误，9 个出现挂起（详见问题 #915）。

paragraphs.en: shows one of the three kernel bugs. All three are deep: they lie on ext4 ’s EXT4_IOC_GROUP_ADD resize path. They sit eight frames below the f_op->unlocked_ioctl icall at line 2, which is the only entry from user space to that path. R 0 R_{0} leaves that site empty and the refined call graph resolves it to ext4_ioctl among six others. The bug shown tests its bound at line 12, after the read. Hence, the loop reads one entry past the block, and the count it returns can equal the block’s capacity. The caller uses that count as an index into the same block at line 17: the resize succeeds while writing out of bounds. KASAN confirms all three on Linux 6.12.9 and 7.2.4. Two have been present since ext4 was split from ext3 in 2006, and the third since Linux 3.3.
paragraphs.zh: 展示了三个内核错误中的一个。 这三个错误都涉及深层逻辑：它们位于 ext4 的 EXT4_IOC_GROUP_ADD 扩展路径上。 它们位于第 2 行 f_op->unlocked_ioctl 调用下方八个帧的位置，而该调用是用户空间进入该路径的唯一入口。 R 0 R_{0} 使该位置保持为空，而优化后的调用图则将其解析为 ext4_ioctl 及其他六个调用。 所示错误在第 12 行、读取操作之后测试了其边界条件。 因此，循环会读取一个超出区块范围的条目，其返回的计数可能等于该区块的容量。 调用方在第 17 行使用此计数作为同一区块的索引：在越界写入时，扩展操作成功执行。 KASAN 在 Linux 6.12.9 和 7.2.4 版本中确认了这三个错误。 其中两个错误自 2006 年 ext4 从 ext3 分离以来一直存在，第三个则自 Linux 3.3 版本起存在。

paragraphs.en: Construct validity. Like prior icall evaluations ( Cheng et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2025b ) , we build the reference dynamically, so it is a lower bound on the true targets and every precision figure is conservative. Every resolver is scored on the same reference, so the bound affects all of them alike. While SEA checks selected cases manually ( Cheng et al., 2024 ) , three of our measurements do not depend on the reference. The first is target reduction, which MLTA and Kelp also report (§ 4.3 ). The second is the 98.1 % 98.1\% agreement of the reconstruction with typed IR (§ 4.2 ). The third is the static evidence behind every edge counted as false (§ 4.3 ). Macro-averaging follows SEA and KallGraph. The ordering of R 0 R_{0} , R + R^{+} , and R ± R^{\pm} stays the same when we compute the scores over all edges together or exclude the 398 398 redis macro sites.
paragraphs.zh: 构效度。 与先前的 icall 评估（Cheng et al., 2024；Liu et al., 2024；Li et al., 2025b）类似，我们动态构建参考基准，因此该基准是真实目标的下界，所有精确度数据均为保守估计。 每个解析器都基于相同的参考基准进行评分，因此这一界限对所有解析器的影响均等。 虽然 SEA 会手动检查部分案例（Cheng et al., 2024），但我们有三项测量指标不依赖参考基准。 第一项是目标简化，MLTA 和 Kelp 也报告了这一结果（§4.3）。 第二项是重建结果与带类型标注的 IR 之间的 98.1% 一致性（§4.2）。 第三项是每条被计为错误的边所依据的静态证据（§4.3）。 宏观平均方法遵循 SEA 和 KallGraph。 无论我们将所有边的分数合并计算，还是排除 398 个 redis 宏观站点，R₀、R⁺ 和 R± 的顺序均保持不变。

sents.zh: 构效度。

paragraphs.en: Type-based resolution. These analyses key a site to the functions of a compatible type, and they differ in which type the IR still contains. FLTA uses the signature alone. It is the basis of forward-edge CFI ( Tice et al., 2014 ; Ge et al., 2016 ) and filters our R 0 R_{0} (§ 3.2 ). MLTA ( Lu and Hu, 2019 ) uses the declared type of the loaded field. DeepType ( Xia et al., 2024 ) , TyPM’s module dependence ( Lu, 2023 ) , and Kelp’s regional pointer information ( Cai et al., 2024 ) refine it, and KallGraph ( Li et al., 2025b ) re-expresses its type layers inside a pointer analysis. TFA ( Liu et al., 2024 ) rebuilds the erased struct type from debug metadata and byte offsets, which our recovery also uses. It co-analyzes the rebuilt type with value flow. MLTA, KallGraph, and TFA are our typed-IR baselines, and § 4.1.4 states why DeepType, TyPM, and Kelp are not. What separates Facet from them is which fact it rebuilds: they rebuild the type that keys the match, whereas Facet rebuilds the assignment relation that the type encoded. KallGraph is the nearest in aim: it replaces MLTA’s type-level relation with an object-level one, and differs from Facet in the approximation. It was designed and evaluated on typed IR and not carried to opaque pointers. KallGraph establishes function-to-call as reachability along an on-demand traversal. Hence, it keeps object instances apart but leaves a site empty wherever the traversal breaks. Facet instead establishes function-to-call as a join on the field key, which needs no end-to-end path but merges the instances of a struct type (§ 4.4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 基于类型的解析。 这些分析将某个位置与兼容类型的功能关联起来，而它们之间的差异在于 IR 仍包含哪种类型。 FLTA 仅使用签名。 它是前向边 CFI（Tice 等人，2014；Ge 等人，2016）的基础，并对我们的 R₀（§ 3.2）进行过滤。 MLTA（Lu 和 Hu，2019）使用已声明的加载字段的类型。 DeepType（Xia 等人，2024）、TyPM 的模块依赖关系（Lu，2023）以及 Kelp 的区域指针信息（Cai 等人，2024）对其进行了改进，而 KallGraph（Li 等人，2025b）则在指针分析中重新表达了其类型层次结构。 TFA（Liu 等人，2024）从调试元数据和字节偏移量中重建了被删除的结构体类型，我们的恢复方法也使用了这一技术。 它会将重建的类型与值流进行联合分析。 MLTA、KallGraph 和 TFA 是我们基于类型 IR 的基线方法，而 § 4.1.4 说明了为何 DeepType、TyPM 和 Kelp 不属于此类。 Facet 与这些方法的不同之处在于它重建了何种事实：它们重建的是用于匹配的关键类型，而 Facet 重建的是该类型所编码的赋值关系。 KallGraph 在目标上最为接近：它将 MLTA 的类型级关系替换为对象级关系，但在近似方式上与 Facet 有所不同。 它最初是针对带类型标注的 IR 设计和评估的，并未扩展至不透明指针。 KallGraph 将函数到调用的关系定义为按需遍历路径上的可达性。 因此，它将对象实例彼此分离，但在遍历中断的位置会留下空位。 相比之下，Facet 将函数到调用的关系定义为字段键上的连接操作，这无需端到端的路径，但会合并结构体类型的各个实例（§ 4.4）。

paragraphs.en: Resolution on opaque IR. TypeCopilot ( Zhou et al., 2025 ) is the only prior icall analysis for opaque IR. It re-infers the erased pointee types so that MLTA can match on them again, and § 4.4 compares against it. Source-level types can also be recovered from debug metadata ( Hück et al., 2025 ) or re-inferred for compiler optimization ( Nicolosi et al., 2026 ) , whereas we consult the debug layouts for the dispatched field alone.
paragraphs.zh: 关于不透明 IR 的决议。 TypeCopilot（Zhou 等人，2025）是唯一先前对不透明 IR 进行的 icall 分析。 它重新推断被擦除的点指针类型，以便 MLTA 能够再次基于这些类型进行匹配，并且 §4.4 会对此进行比较。 源级类型也可以从调试元数据中恢复（Hück 等人，2025），或为编译器优化而重新推断（Nicolosi 等人，2026），而我们仅针对调度的字段查阅调试布局。

paragraphs.en: Learned resolution. SEA ( Cheng et al., 2024 ) asks an LLM whether a caller summary matches a callee summary and keeps the majority answer over repeated queries. Callee ( Zhu et al., 2023 ) learns the same decision for binaries, where neither debug layouts nor a points-to solution is available. Both adopt the model’s answer as an edge, with at most a majority vote over repeated queries, because no program evidence checks it (§ 2.2 ). Instead, Facet classifies the model’s facts by the rules that classify the symbolic ones, and the warrants take precedence over the model’s facts.
paragraphs.zh: 学习式解决。 SEA（Cheng 等人，2024）会询问 LLM 调用者摘要是否与被调用者摘要匹配，并在重复查询中保留多数答案。 Callee（Zhu 等人，2023）针对二进制文件学习了相同的决策，此时既没有调试布局，也没有指向解。 两者都将模型的答案视为一条边，最多通过重复查询进行多数投票，因为没有程序证据可以验证它（§ 2.2）。 相反，Facet 根据对符号事实进行分类的规则来对模型的事实进行分类，且依据理由的优先级高于模型的事实。
